- error string - Error type identifier

### Create a new chat widget
POST /chat-widget/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/chat-widget/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/create-chat-widget | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/create-chat-widget.md

Creates a new chat widget for a specific location

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: chat-widget.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateWidgetDTO:
- version* number (e.g. 2) - Version
- chatType* string (enum: liveChat | emailChat; e.g. "emailChat") - Chat Type. The public API supports only liveChat and emailChat; any other value is rejected with a 422.
- name* string (e.g. "Chat Widget 1") - Name
- locationId* string (e.g. "oHJiAh0wDG3BzmzACVD6") - Location ID
- deleted boolean - Deleted
- default boolean - Default
- settings object - Settings
  - acknowledgementDetails object - Acknowledgement Details
    - icon string | string (e.g. "Check") - Acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
      - option 1: string
      - option 2: string
    - placeholderColor string (e.g. "#000") - Placeholder color
    - liveChatIcon string | string (e.g. "Check") - Live-chat acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
      - option 1: string
      - option 2: string
    - liveChatPlaceholderColor string (e.g. "#000") - Placeholder color for live chat

  - agencyWebsite string (e.g. "https://example.com") - Website URL of the agency

  - countryCode string (e.g. "US") - Country code
  - chatType string (enum: liveChat | emailChat; e.g. "emailChat") - Chat Type. The public API supports only liveChat and emailChat; any other value is rejected with a 422.
  - promptType string (enum: avatar | normal; e.g. "avatar") - Chat bubble style — "avatar" shows the agent avatar, "normal" shows a plain bubble.
  - chatIcon string | string (e.g. "messageChatCircle") - Icon shown on the closed chat bubble. Either a preset name (`messageChatCircle`, `messageChatSquare`, `messageSquare`, `messageDotsCircle`, `messageWhatsApp`, `phoneCall01`, `phone`, `phoneOutgoing02`, `fbMessenger`, `instagram`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.

    - option 2: string
  - enableRevisitMessage boolean - Boolean indicating whether to enable a revisit message

  - liveChatFeedbackMsg string (e.g. "We would appreciate your feedback. Please rate your experience.") - Message asking for feedback after a live chat
  - liveChatFeedbackNote string (e.g. "Your feedback helps us improve our services.") - Note regarding live chat feedback
  - liveChatIntroMsg string (e.g. "Hello! Welcome to our live chat support. How can I assist you today?") - Introduction message for a live chat
  - liveChatUserInactiveMsg string (e.g. "Are you still there? Please let us know if you need assistance.") - Message for inactive users during a live chat
  - liveChatUserInactiveTime string (e.g. "5 minutes") - Time for considering a user inactive during a live chat
  - liveChatVisitorInactiveMsg string (e.g. "Looks like you stepped away. Feel free to return whenever you need help.") - Message for inactive visitors during a live chat
  - liveChatVisitorInactiveTime string (e.g. "10 minutes") - Time for considering a visitor inactive during a live chat
  - locale string (enum: location | auto | en-us | en-gb | de | fr-fr | nl | hu | pt-pt | pt-br | es | fr-ca | hr | it | sv-se | da-dk | fi | no; e.g. "en-us") - Locale setting. Use "location" to inherit from the location's locale, or "auto" to detect from the visitor's browser. Otherwise pick a BCP 47 tag in hyphen-lowercase form.
  - promptAvatar string (e.g. "avatar.jpg") - Avatar for prompts
  - promptAvatarAltText string (e.g. "company logo") - Prompt Avatar Alt Text

  - showConsentCheckbox boolean - Boolean indicating whether to show a consent checkbox

  - showPrompt boolean - Boolean indicating whether to show prompts
  - subHeading string (e.g. "We are here to help you!") - Subheading text

### Delete a Chat Widget
DELETE /chat-widget/{locationId}/{id}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/chat-widget/{locationId}/{id}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/delete-chat-widget | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/delete-chat-widget.md

Deletes a chat widget by ID

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: chat-widget.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- id* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRWsss") - The chat widget ID
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRWsss") - The location ID

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- _id* string - Chat widget ID
- version* number - Schema version of the widget
- chatType* string (enum: liveChat | waChat | emailChat | allInOneChat | voiceAiChat | facebookChat | instagramChat) - Chat Type. Reads are not restricted to the public-API write allow-list, so any stored chat type can be returned here.
- name* string - Widget name
- locationId* string - The location ID that owns this widget
- deleted* boolean - Whether the widget is soft-deleted
- default* boolean - Whether this is the default widget for the location
- settings object - Widget settings

      - outsideOfficeHoursWelcomeMsg string - Time Zone

      - label string - Display label shown next to the field in the form.
      - value string - Field identifier. For standard fields use one of: `name`, `phone`, `email`, `message`. For custom fields use the contact custom-field id.
      - dataType string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | TEXTAREA | EMAIL | PHONE | DATE | NUMERICAL | MONETORY | SINGLE_OPTIONS) - Data type of the field, used to pick the input control and validation.

      - fieldKey string - Dotted field key used to write the value onto the contact (e.g. `contact.email`).
      - required boolean - Whether the field must be filled in to submit the form.
      - id string - Client-assigned field identifier; the chat-widget UI round-trips this on save.
      - disabled boolean - Whether the field is shown but disabled in the form editor.
      - picklistOptions string[] - Choices for option-type custom fields (SINGLE_OPTIONS, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, RADIO, CHECKBOX).

    - allInOneInitialMsg string - All In One Initial Msg
    - contactFormIntroMessage string - Contact Form Intro Message

### List Chat Widgets
GET /chat-widget/list
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/chat-widget/list
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/list-chat-widgets | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/list-chat-widgets.md

Retrieves a list of chat widgets for a specific location

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: chat-widget.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRWsss") - The location ID
- offset* string (e.g. "0") - Row offset. Defaults to 0, capped at 10000.
- limit* string (e.g. "10") - Page size. Must be greater than 0, capped at 100.
- chatType string (enum: liveChat | waChat | emailChat | allInOneChat | voiceAiChat | facebookChat | instagramChat | webChat; e.g. "emailChat") - The type of chat widget. Supports normal ChatType values, plus the virtual umbrella "webChat" (maps to facebookChat/emailChat/instagramChat/waChat).
- excludeChatType string (enum: liveChat | waChat | emailChat | allInOneChat | voiceAiChat | facebookChat | instagramChat; e.g. "voiceAiChat") - The type of chat widget
- voiceAiAgentId string (e.g. "66597c9a41106ba6eb4eac3c") - The voice AI agent ID
- creationSource string (enum: chat-widget | a2pCompliance | public-api | snapshot; e.g. "chat-widget") - The source that created the widget
- excludeCreationSource string (enum: chat-widget | a2pCompliance | public-api | snapshot; e.g. "a2pCompliance") - Exclude widgets with this creation source

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- chatWidgets* object[] - Matching chat widgets for this page
  - _id* string - Chat widget ID
  - name* string - Widget name
  - chatType* string (enum: liveChat | waChat | emailChat | allInOneChat | voiceAiChat | facebookChat | instagramChat) - Chat Type. Reads are not restricted to the public-API write allow-list, so any stored chat type can be returned here.
  - default* boolean - Whether this is the default widget for the location
  - creationSource string (enum: chat-widget | a2pCompliance | public-api | snapshot) - How the widget was created
  - settings object - Projected subset of settings returned for list rows
  - createdAt* string - Creation timestamp (ISO 8601)
  - updatedAt* string - Last update timestamp (ISO 8601)
- totalCount* number - Total widgets matching the filters, ignoring limit and offset

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 422 (400, 401, 403, 422: see Common error responses)

### Patch Chat Widget

Path parameters:

  - acknowledgementDetails object - Acknowledgement Details
    - icon string | string (e.g. "Check") - Acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.

Either a preset name (`messageChatCircle`, `messageChatSquare`, `messageSquare`, `messageDotsCircle`, `messageWhatsApp`, `phoneCall01`, `phone`, `phoneOutgoing02`, `fbMessenger`, `instagram`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
    - option 1: string

  - liveChatVisitorInactiveTime string (e.g. "10 minutes") - Time for considering a visitor inactive during a live chat
  - locale string (enum: location | auto | en-us | en-gb | de | fr-fr | nl | hu | pt-pt | pt-br | es | fr-ca | hr | it | sv-se | da-dk | fi | no; e.g. "en-us") - Locale setting.       - avatarBackgroundColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Avatar Background Color
      - avatarBorderColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Avatar Border Color
      - senderMessageColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Sender Message Color
      - receivedMessageColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Received Message Color
    - typography object - Typography Options
      - fontFamily string (e.g. "inter") - Font Family
      - colors object - Typography Color Options
        - senderMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Sender Message Text Color
        - receivedMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Received Message Text Color
        - headerMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Header Message Text Color
        - welcomeMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - Welcome Message Text Color
        - systemMessageTextColor string (e.g. "#fffff") - System Message Text Color
  - waNumber string (e.g. "+1234567890") - WhatsApp number
  - widgetPrimaryColor string (e.g. "#4285F4") - Primary color for the widget
  - representativeAssignedMessage string (e.g. "#4285F4") - Representative Assigned Message
  - dimensions object - Customizations
    - position string (enum: top-left | top-right | middle-left | middle-right | bottom-left | bottom-right; e.g. "bottom-right") - Widget anchor position on the host page (kebab-case).
    - sizes object - Widget dimensions (width/height)
      - width number | string (e.g. 360) - Width in pixels. Accepts a number (360), a CSS length ("600px"), or "" for auto.
        - option 1: number
        - option 2: string
      - height number | string (e.g. 640) - Height in pixels. Accepts a number (640), a CSS length ("600px"), or "" for auto.
        - option 1: number
        - option 2: string

    - brandingTitle string (e.g. "Agency") - Branding Title
    - redirect object - Redirect Object
      - redirectAction boolean - Redirect Action
      - redirectWebsite string (e.g. "www.example.com") - Redirect Website
      - redirectText string (e.g. "Click here") - Redirect Text
    - enableContactForm boolean - Boolean for showing contact form at start
    - defaultConsentCheck boolean - By default consent check for contact form
    - businessOfficeHours object - Business Office Hours
      - enableBusinessHours boolean - Enable Business Hours
      - openHours object[] - Open Hours
        - daysOfTheWeek string[] (e.g. [1]) - Day of week
        - hours string[] - Hours
      - timezone string (e.g. "UTC") - Time Zone
      - outsideOfficeHoursWelcomeMsg string (e.g. "Asia/Calcutta") - Time Zone
    - contactFormOptions object[] - Ordered list of fields shown on the chat-widget contact form. Standard fields are identified by `value` = `name | phone | email | message`; custom fields use the contact custom-field id.
      - label string (e.g. "Email") - Display label shown next to the field in the form.
      - value string (e.g. "email") - Field identifier. For standard fields use one of: `name`, `phone`, `email`, `message`. For custom fields use the contact custom-field id.
      - dataType string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | TEXTAREA | EMAIL | PHONE | DATE | NUMERICAL | MONETORY | SINGLE_OPTIONS; e.g. "EMAIL") - Data type of the field, used to pick the input control and validation.
      - placeholder string (e.g. "Email") - Placeholder text rendered inside the input.
      - fieldKey string (e.g. "contact.email") - Dotted field key used to write the value onto the contact (e.g. `contact.email`).
      - required boolean - Whether the field must be filled in to submit the form.
      - id string (e.g. "1") - Client-assigned field identifier; the chat-widget UI round-trips this on save.
      - disabled boolean - Whether the field is shown but disabled in the form editor.
      - picklistOptions string[] (e.g. ["Option 1","Option 2"]) - Choices for option-type custom fields (SINGLE_OPTIONS, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, RADIO, CHECKBOX).
    - allInOneChatTypes string[] (e.g. []) - All In One Chat Type

      - instagramPageId string (e.g. "1234567890") - Instagram Page ID
      - instagramUsername string (e.g. "Instagram UserName") - Instagram UserName
    - playNotificationSound boolean - Play Notification Sound
    - allowVoiceNotes boolean - Allow visitors to record and send voice notes from the chat window
    - allowAttachments boolean - Allow visitors to send attachments (images, PDFs, files) alongside their messages
    - voiceAiSendActionText string (e.g. "Call Now") - Voice Ai Send Action Text
    - voiceAiDisplayMode string (enum: avatar | visualiser; e.g. "avatar") - Voice AI display mode
    - voiceAiAnimation string (enum: 1; e.g. "1") - Voice AI Animation ID. Only "1" is supported for now.
    - voiceAiAnimationColor string (e.g. "#155EEF") - Voice AI animation visualiser color
    - voiceAiAnimationSize string (enum: sm | md | lg; e.g. "md") - Voice AI animation size for the embedded visualiser orb
    - addSupportingText boolean - Add Supporting Text
    - supportingText string (e.g. "We are here to help you") - Supporting Text
  - locationCountryCode string (e.g. "US") - Location Country Code
  - widgetPlacement string (enum: sticky | embedded; e.g. "embedded") - Widget Placement. "sticky" keeps the widget pinned to a page corner; "embedded" renders inline within the host page.
  - loadStrategy string (enum: immediate | interaction; e.g. "interaction") - Load strategy for the embed script: "immediate" loads on page load (default), "interaction" defers until user interacts.

Response 200 (Success) application/json:

### Update Chat Widget
PUT /chat-widget/data/{locationId}/{id}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/chat-widget/data/{locationId}/{id}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/update-chat-widget | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/chat-widget/update-chat-widget.md

Replaces an existing chat widget with the provided configuration

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: chat-widget.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- id* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRWsss") - The chat widget ID
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRWsss") - The location ID

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateWidgetDTO:
- version number (e.g. 2) - Version
- chatType string (enum: liveChat | emailChat; e.g. "emailChat") - Chat Type. The public API supports only liveChat and emailChat; any other value is rejected with a 422.
- name string (e.g. "Chat Widget 1") - Name
- default boolean - Default
- settings object - Settings
  - acknowledgementDetails object - Acknowledgement Details
    - icon string | string (e.g. "Check") - Acknowledgement icon. Either a preset name (`Check`, `CheckCircle`, `MessageDotsCircle`, `MessageSmileSquare`) or an absolute URL to a custom uploaded image.
      - option 1: string
      - option 2: string
    - placeholderColor string (e.g. "#000") - Placeholder color

      - option 2: string

  - option 1 TextField: object

    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field

    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field

    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field

    - field_value object (deprecated) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
- source string (e.g. "public api") - Source from which the contact was created
- dateOfBirth object (nullable; e.g. "1990-09-25") - The birth date of the contact. Supported formats: YYYY/MM/DD, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD-YYYY, YYYY.MM.DD, MM.DD.YYYY, YYYY_MM_DD, MM_DD_YYYY
- country string (e.g. "US") - Country code of the contact (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
- companyName string (nullable; e.g. "DGS VolMAX") - Company name of the contact
- assignedTo string (e.g. "y0BeYjuRIlDwsDcOHOJo") - User's Id
- additionalEmails object[] (maxItems: 10) - Add additional email addresses to a contact. > ⚠️ **Important:** When sending `additionalEmails`, you must also include the contact’s current primary `email` in the same request.<br>If you send `additionalEmails` without `email`, the contact’s existing primary email may be cleared or replaced. <ul style="list-style: disc; padding-left: 1.5rem"> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>email</code> represents the contact’s <strong>primary email address</strong>.</li> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>additionalEmails</code> represents secondary email addresses for the same contact.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">Always send the primary <code>email</code> together with <code>additionalEmails</code> when updating email addresses.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">A maximum of <strong>10 additional email addresses</strong> can be provided.</li> </ul> Example ```json { "email": "john@example.com", "additionalEmails": [ { "email": "john.work@example.com" } ] } ``` Avoid ```json { "additionalEmails": [ { "email": "john.work@example.com" } ] } ``` Sending only `additionalEmails` may cause the existing primary email to be lost. If email uniqueness is enabled for the location, every email address in the request—primary and additional—must be unique across contacts. If any email already belongs to another contact, the request fails with **400 Bad Request** and no changes are saved.
  - email* string (e.g. "rosan@deos.com") - Additional Email
- additionalPhones object[] (maxItems: 10) - Add additional phone numbers to a contact. > ⚠️ **Important:** When sending `additionalPhones`, you must also include the contact’s current primary `phone` in the same request.<br>If you send `additionalPhones` without `phone`, the contact’s existing primary phone may be cleared or replaced. <ul style="list-style: disc; padding-left: 1.5rem"> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>phone</code> represents the contact’s <strong>primary phone number</strong>.</li> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>additionalPhones</code> represents secondary phone numbers for the same contact.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">Always send the primary <code>phone</code> together with <code>additionalPhones</code> when updating phone numbers.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">A maximum of <strong>10 additional phone numbers</strong> can be provided.</li> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>phoneLabel</code> is optional. Allowed values: <code>Home</code>, <code>Work</code>, <code>Mobile</code>, or <code>Landline</code>. A label can belong to only one phone number on the contact, including the primary. If a label is repeated, it is kept on the first phone number and removed from the others.</li> </ul> Example ```json { "phone": "+14155550100", "additionalPhones": [ { "phone": "+14155550101", "phoneLabel": "Work" } ] } ``` Avoid ```json { "additionalPhones": [ { "phone": "+14155550101", "phoneLabel": "Work" } ] } ``` Sending only `additionalPhones` may cause the existing primary phone number to be lost. If phone uniqueness is enabled for the location, every phone number in the request—primary and additional—must be unique across contacts. If any phone number already belongs to another contact, the request fails with **400 Bad Request** and no changes are saved.
  - phone* string (e.g. "7017345098") - Additional Phones
  - phoneLabel string (enum: Home | Work | Mobile | Landline; e.g. "Mobile") - Label
- dndSettings object - Per-channel DND settings for the contact
  - call object - DND settings for phone calls

  - email object - DND settings for email

  - whatsApp object - DND settings for WhatsApp
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - gmb object - DND settings for Google My Business
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel

### Lookup Contact By Email Or Phone
GET /contacts/lookup
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/contacts/lookup
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/lookup-contact | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/lookup-contact.md

Look up contacts matching an exact `email` or `phone`, scoped to a location, up to `limit` contacts (max 20) per page. Also matches against a contact's additional emails and additional phone numbers. Exactly one of `email` or `phone` must be provided. Paginate with `nextCursor`. Returns an empty `contacts` array if no contact matches. OAuth channel only.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: contacts.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id. Must be a non-empty string.
- email string (e.g. "abc@abc.com") - Exact email to look up (case-insensitive), mutually exclusive with `phone`.
- phone string (e.g. "+1423164516") - Exact phone number to look up, in E.164 format, mutually exclusive with `email`.
- nextCursor string (e.g. "eyJkYXRlQWRkZWQiOjE3MDAwMDAwMDAwMDAsImlkIjoiYy1sYXN0In0=") - Opaque pagination cursor returned as `nextCursor` by a previous request.
- limit integer (e.g. 20) - Max number of contacts to return per page. Defaults to 20, capped at 20.

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- contacts object[] - Contacts matching the given email or phone, up to the requested `limit` (max 20)
  - id string - Unique identifier of the contact
  - name string - Full name of the contact
  - locationId string - Location Id the contact belongs to
  - firstName string - First name of the contact
  - lastName string - Last name of the contact
  - email string - Email address of the contact
  - emailLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact email
  - timezone string - Timezone of the contact
  - companyName string - Company name of the contact
  - phone string - Phone number of the contact
  - dnd boolean - Whether Do Not Disturb is enabled for the contact
  - type string - Contact type classification
  - source string - Source from which the contact was created
  - assignedTo string - User Id the contact is assigned to
  - address1 string - Street address of the contact
  - city string - City of the contact
  - state string - State of the contact
  - country string - Country of the contact
  - postalCode string - Postal code of the contact
  - website string - Website URL of the contact
  - tags string[] - List of tags associated with the contact
  - dateOfBirth string - Date of birth of the contact (YYYY-MM-DD)
  - dateAdded string - Date and time the contact was added (ISO 8601)
  - dateUpdated string - Date and time the contact was last updated (ISO 8601)
  - attachments string - List of attachment URLs associated with the contact
  - ssn string - Social Security Number (if applicable)
  - keyword string - Search keyword associated with the contact
  - firstNameLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact first name
  - fullNameLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact full name
  - lastNameLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact last name
  - lastActivity string - Date and time of last activity on this contact (ISO 8601)
  - customFields object[] - List of custom field values for the contact
    - id string - Unique identifier of the custom field
    - value string - Value of the custom field
  - businessId string - Business Id the contact is associated with
  - attributionSource object - First-touch attribution source details for the contact
    - url* string - Attribution source type
    - campaign string (nullable) - Campaign name
    - utmSource string (nullable) - UTM source parameter
    - utmMedium string (nullable) - UTM medium parameter
    - utmContent string (nullable) - UTM content parameter
    - referrer string (nullable) - Referrer URL
    - campaignId string (nullable) - Campaign Id
    - fbclid string (nullable) - Facebook click Id
    - gclid string (nullable) - Google click Id
    - msclikid string (nullable) - Microsoft click Id
    - dclid string (nullable) - DoubleClick click Id
    - fbc string (nullable) - Facebook browser Id
    - fbp string (nullable) - Facebook pixel Id
    - fbEventId string (nullable) - Facebook event Id
    - userAgent string (nullable) - Browser user agent string
    - ip string (nullable) - IP address of the visitor
    - medium string (nullable) - Attribution medium (e.g. survey, funnel)
    - mediumId string (nullable) - Id of the attribution medium
  - lastAttributionSource object - Last-touch attribution source details for the contact
    - url* string - Attribution source type
    - campaign string (nullable) - Campaign name
    - utmSource string (nullable) - UTM source parameter
    - utmMedium string (nullable) - UTM medium parameter
    - utmContent string (nullable) - UTM content parameter
    - referrer string (nullable) - Referrer URL
    - campaignId string (nullable) - Campaign Id
    - fbclid string (nullable) - Facebook click Id
    - gclid string (nullable) - Google click Id
    - msclikid string (nullable) - Microsoft click Id
    - dclid string (nullable) - DoubleClick click Id
    - fbc string (nullable) - Facebook browser Id
    - fbp string (nullable) - Facebook pixel Id
    - fbEventId string (nullable) - Facebook event Id
    - userAgent string (nullable) - Browser user agent string
    - ip string (nullable) - IP address of the visitor
    - medium string (nullable) - Attribution medium (e.g. survey, funnel)
    - mediumId string (nullable) - Id of the attribution medium
  - additionalEmails object[] - Additional emails associated with the contact
    - email* string - Additional Email
  - additionalPhones object[] - Additional phone numbers associated with the contact
    - phone* string - Additional Phones
    - phoneLabel string (enum: Home | Work | Mobile | Landline) - Label
  - visitorId string - visitorId is the Unique ID assigned to each Live chat visitor.
  - dndSettings object - Per-channel DND settings for the contact
    - call object - DND settings for phone calls

Update a contact using contactId

> ⚠️ **When updating additional emails/phones, always include the current primary `email`/`phone` in the same request. Otherwise, the existing primary value may be lost.**

    - message string (e.g. "Please do not contact me via this channel") - Custom message associated with the inbound DND setting
- tags string[] (e.g. ["nisi sint commodo amet","consequat"]) - This field will overwrite all current tags associated with the contact. To update a tags, it is recommended to use the Add Tag or Remove Tag API instead.
- customFields (object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object)[] - List of custom field values to assign to the contact

    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field

- assignedTo string (nullable; e.g. "y0BeYjuRIlDwsDcOHOJo") - User's Id
- additionalEmails object[] (maxItems: 10) - Add additional email addresses to a contact. > ⚠️ **Important:** When sending `additionalEmails`, you must also include the contact’s current primary `email` in the same request.<br>If you send `additionalEmails` without `email`, the contact’s existing primary email may be cleared or replaced. <ul style="list-style: disc; padding-left: 1.5rem"> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>email</code> represents the contact’s <strong>primary email address</strong>.</li> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>additionalEmails</code> represents secondary email addresses for the same contact.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">Always send the primary <code>email</code> together with <code>additionalEmails</code> when updating email addresses.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">A maximum of <strong>10 additional email addresses</strong> can be provided.</li> </ul> Example ```json { "email": "john@example.com", "additionalEmails": [ { "email": "john.work@example.com" } ] } ``` Avoid ```json { "additionalEmails": [ { "email": "john.work@example.com" } ] } ``` Sending only `additionalEmails` may cause the existing primary email to be lost. If email uniqueness is enabled for the location, every email address in the request—primary and additional—must be unique across contacts. If any email already belongs to another contact, the request fails with **400 Bad Request** and no changes are saved.
  - email* string (e.g. "rosan@deos.com") - Additional Email
- additionalPhones object[] (maxItems: 10) - Add additional phone numbers to a contact. > ⚠️ **Important:** When sending `additionalPhones`, you must also include the contact’s current primary `phone` in the same request.<br>If you send `additionalPhones` without `phone`, the contact’s existing primary phone may be cleared or replaced. <ul style="list-style: disc; padding-left: 1.5rem"> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>phone</code> represents the contact’s <strong>primary phone number</strong>.</li> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>additionalPhones</code> represents secondary phone numbers for the same contact.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">Always send the primary <code>phone</code> together with <code>additionalPhones</code> when updating phone numbers.</li> <li style="list-style: disc">A maximum of <strong>10 additional phone numbers</strong> can be provided.</li> <li style="list-style: disc"><code>phoneLabel</code> is optional. Allowed values: <code>Home</code>, <code>Work</code>, <code>Mobile</code>, or <code>Landline</code>. A label can belong to only one phone number on the contact, including the primary. If a label is repeated, it is kept on the first phone number and removed from the others.</li> </ul> Example ```json { "phone": "+14155550100", "additionalPhones": [ { "phone": "+14155550101", "phoneLabel": "Work" } ] } ``` Avoid ```json { "additionalPhones": [ { "phone": "+14155550101", "phoneLabel": "Work" } ] } ``` Sending only `additionalPhones` may cause the existing primary phone number to be lost. If phone uniqueness is enabled for the location, every phone number in the request—primary and additional—must be unique across contacts. If any phone number already belongs to another contact, the request fails with **400 Bad Request** and no changes are saved.
  - phone* string (e.g. "7017345098") - Additional Phones

### Upsert Contact
POST /contacts/upsert
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/contacts/upsert
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/upsert-contact | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/contacts/upsert-contact.md

The Upsert API will adhere to the configuration defined under the "Allow Duplicate Contact" setting at the Location level. If the setting is configured to check both Email and Phone, the API will attempt to identify an existing contact based on the priority sequence specified in the setting, and will create or update the contact accordingly.<br/><br/>If two separate contacts already exist—one with the same email and another with the same phone—and an upsert request includes both the email and phone, the API will update the contact that matches the first field in the configured sequence, and ignore the second field to prevent duplication.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: contacts.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) UpsertContactDtoV3:
- firstName string (nullable; e.g. "Rosan") - First name of the contact
- lastName string (nullable; e.g. "Deo") - Last name of the contact
- name string (nullable; e.g. "Rosan Deo") - Full name of the contact
- email string (nullable; e.g. "rosan@deos.com") - Email address of the contact
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id the contact should be created under
- gender string (e.g. "male") - Gender of the contact
- phone string (nullable; e.g. "+1 888-888-8888") - Phone number of the contact
- address1 string (nullable; e.g. "3535 1st St N") - Street address of the contact
- city string (nullable; e.g. "Dolomite") - City of the contact
- state string (nullable; e.g. "AL") - State of the contact
- postalCode string (e.g. "35061") - Postal code of the contact
- website string (nullable; e.g. "https://www.tesla.com") - Website URL of the contact
- timezone string (nullable; e.g. "America/Chihuahua") - Timezone of the contact
- dnd boolean - Whether Do Not Disturb is enabled for the contact
- inboundDndSettings object - Inbound DND settings per channel for the contact
  - all object - Inbound DND settings applied to all channels
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive; e.g. "active") - Inbound DND status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Please do not contact me via this channel") - Custom message associated with the inbound DND setting
- tags string[] (e.g. ["nisi sint commodo amet","consequat"]) - This field will overwrite all current tags associated with the contact. To update a tags, it is recommended to use the Add Tag or Remove Tag API instead.
- customFields (object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object)[] - List of custom field values to assign to the contact
  - option 1 TextField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Text") - Text value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Text") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 2 LargeTextField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Text") - Large text value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Text") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 3 SingleSelectField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Selected Option") - Selected option value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Selected Option") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 4 RadioField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string (e.g. "My Selected Option") - Selected radio option value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string (deprecated; e.g. "My Selected Option") - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 5 NumericField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue object (e.g. 100) - Numeric value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value object (deprecated; e.g. 100) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 6 MonetoryField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue object (e.g. 100.5) - Monetary value for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value object (deprecated; e.g. 100.5) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 7 CheckboxField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string[] (e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Array of selected checkbox values for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string[] (deprecated; e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 8 MultiSelectField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue string[] (e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Array of selected values for the custom field (preferred).
    - field_value string[] (deprecated; e.g. ["test","test2"]) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
  - option 9 FileField: object
    - id* string (e.g. "6dvNaf7VhkQ9snc5vnjJ") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - key string (e.g. "my_custom_field") - Pass either `id` or `key` of custom field
    - fieldValue object - File upload value — a map of UUID to file metadata and download URL (preferred).
    - field_value object (deprecated) - Deprecated. Use `fieldValue` instead.
- source string (e.g. "public api") - Source from which the contact was created
- dateOfBirth object (nullable; e.g. "1990-09-25") - The birth date of the contact. Supported formats: YYYY/MM/DD, MM/DD/YYYY, YYYY-MM-DD, MM-DD-YYYY, YYYY.MM.DD, MM.DD.YYYY, YYYY_MM_DD, MM_DD_YYYY
- country string (e.g. "US") - Country code of the contact (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2)
- companyName string (nullable; e.g. "DGS VolMAX") - Company name of the contact
- assignedTo string (e.g. "y0BeYjuRIlDwsDcOHOJo") - User's Id
- createNewIfDuplicateAllowed boolean (default: false) - Controls whether to create a new contact or update an existing duplicate. **Scenario 1:** If this value is `true` and the location allows duplicate contacts, a new contact will be created immediately without checking for duplicates. **Scenario 2:** If this value is `true` but the location does not allow duplicate contacts, this field is ignored and the normal upsert behavior applies: the API will search for an existing duplicate contact, update it if found, or create a new contact if not found. **Scenario 3:** If this value is `false` or not provided, the normal upsert behavior applies regardless of the location's duplicate contact setting.
- dndSettings object - Per-channel DND settings for the contact
  - call object - DND settings for phone calls
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - email object - DND settings for email
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - sms object - DND settings for SMS
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - whatsApp object - DND settings for WhatsApp
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - gmb object - DND settings for Google My Business
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason
  - fb object - DND settings for Facebook
    - status* string (enum: active | inactive | permanent; e.g. "active") - Do Not Disturb status for this channel
    - message string (e.g. "Do not contact via this channel") - Custom message associated with the DND setting
    - code string (e.g. "OPTED_OUT") - DND code or reason

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- new boolean - Whether a new contact was created (true) or an existing one was updated (false)

  - id string - Unique identifier of the contact
  - name string - Full name of the contact

  - firstName string - First name of the contact

  - city string - City of the contact

  - country string - Country of the contact
  - postalCode string - Postal code of the contact
  - website string - Website URL of the contact
  - tags string[] - List of tags associated with the contact
  - dateOfBirth string - Date of birth of the contact (YYYY-MM-DD)
  - dateAdded string - Date and time the contact was added (ISO 8601)
  - dateUpdated string - Date and time the contact was last updated (ISO 8601)
  - attachments string - List of attachment URLs associated with the contact
  - ssn string - Social Security Number (if applicable)

  - fullNameLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact full name
  - lastNameLowerCase string - Lowercase version of the contact last name
  - lastActivity string - Date and time of last activity on this contact (ISO 8601)
  - customFields object[] - List of custom field values for the contact
    - id string - Unique identifier of the custom field
    - value string - Value of the custom field
  - businessId string - Business Id the contact is associated with
  - attributionSource object - First-touch attribution source details for the contact
    - url* string - Attribution source type
    - campaign string (nullable) - Campaign name
    - utmSource string (nullable) - UTM source parameter
    - utmMedium string (nullable) - UTM medium parameter
    - utmContent string (nullable) - UTM content parameter

    - fbclid string (nullable) - Facebook click Id
    - gclid string (nullable) - Google click Id
    - msclikid string (nullable) - Microsoft click Id
    - dclid string (nullable) - DoubleClick click Id
    - fbc string (nullable) - Facebook browser Id
    - fbp string (nullable) - Facebook pixel Id
    - fbEventId string (nullable) - Facebook event Id
    - userAgent string (nullable) - Browser user agent string
    - ip string (nullable) - IP address of the visitor
    - medium string (nullable) - Attribution medium (e.g. survey, funnel)
    - mediumId string (nullable) - Id of the attribution medium
  - lastAttributionSource object - Last-touch attribution source details for the contact
    - url* string - Attribution source type
    - campaign string (nullable) - Campaign name
    - utmSource string (nullable) - UTM source parameter
    - utmMedium string (nullable) - UTM medium parameter
    - utmContent string (nullable) - UTM content parameter
    - referrer string (nullable) - Referrer URL
    - campaignId string (nullable) - Campaign Id
    - fbclid string (nullable) - Facebook click Id
    - gclid string (nullable) - Google click Id
    - msclikid string (nullable) - Microsoft click Id
    - dclid string (nullable) - DoubleClick click Id
    - fbc string (nullable) - Facebook browser Id
    - fbp string (nullable) - Facebook pixel Id
    - fbEventId string (nullable) - Facebook event Id
    - userAgent string (nullable) - Browser user agent string
    - ip string (nullable) - IP address of the visitor
    - medium string (nullable) - Attribution medium (e.g. survey, funnel)
    - mediumId string (nullable) - Id of the attribution medium
  - additionalEmails object[] - Additional emails associated with the contact
    - email* string - Additional Email
  - additionalPhones object[] - Additional phone numbers associated with the contact
    - phone* string - Additional Phones
    - phoneLabel string (enum: Home | Work | Mobile | Landline) - Label
  - visitorId string - visitorId is the Unique ID assigned to each Live chat visitor.
  - dndSettings object - Per-channel DND settings for the contact
    - call object - DND settings for phone calls

## Service: conversation-ai (Conversation AI API)

Documentation for AI Employees API

### Attach Action to Agent
POST /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/create-action | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/create-action.md

Creates and attach a new action for an AI agent. Actions define specific tasks or behaviors that the agent can perform, such as booking appointments, sending follow-ups, collecting information, or making an external API call via the `customApi` ("API Call") type. For `customApi`, put the config in `details` (`details.apiConfig` is required) and a per-agent limit (up to 5) applies.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- agentId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - The unique identifier of the AI agent

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateActionDTO:
- type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi; e.g. "triggerWorkflow") - Type of action to perform
- name* string (e.g. "Trigger a Workflow") - Name of the action (3-50 characters)
- details* object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto, and for CUSTOM_API use CustomApiDetailsDTO (the API Call config).
  - option 1 triggerWorkflowDto: object
    - workflowIds* string[] (e.g. ["workflow123","workflow456"]) - Array of workflow IDs to trigger
    - triggerCondition* string (e.g. "When user requests appointment") - Condition that triggers the workflow
    - triggerMessage string (e.g. "Workflow triggered successfully") - Optional message to send when triggering the workflow
  - option 2 updateContactFieldDto: object
    - contactFieldId* string (e.g. "123") - ID of the contact field in Contacts Table
    - description* string (e.g. "Business Name") - Description of the contact field in Contacts Table
    - contactUpdateExamples string[] (default: []; e.g. ["Example 1"]) - Contact update examples in Contacts Table. Not required when using standard fields, Monetory or Date Custom fields.
  - option 3 appointmentBookingDto: object
    - actionId string (e.g. "action123") - Optional action ID reference
    - calendarId* string (e.g. "calendar123") - Calendar ID for appointment booking
    - onlySendLink* boolean - If true, only sends the appointment link without booking
    - triggerWorkflow* boolean - Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - workflowIds string[] (e.g. ["workflow123"]) - Workflow IDs to trigger after booking (required when triggerWorkflow is true)
    - sleepAfterBooking* boolean - Whether to put the agent to sleep after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Unit for sleep time (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Sleep duration (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
    - transferBot* boolean - Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - transferAgent string (e.g. "employee456") - Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)
    - rescheduleEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
  - option 4 stopBotDto: object
    - stopBotDetectionType* string (enum: Goodbye | Custom; e.g. "Custom") - Type of stop bot detection - Goodbye or Custom
    - stopBotTriggerCondition* string (e.g. "When the user says they no longer need assistance or want to end the conversation") - Condition that triggers stopping the bot
    - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - enabled* boolean - Whether this action is enabled for the agent
    - stopBotExamples* string[] (e.g. ["goodbye","thank you","no more questions"]) - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
    - finalMessage* string (e.g. "Thank you for contacting us. Have a great day!") - Final message sent when stopping the bot
    - tags string[] (e.g. ["resolved","no-response"]) - Tags to apply when stopping the bot
  - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object
    - enabled* boolean - Whether human handover action is enabled
    - triggerCondition* string (e.g. "When the user requests to speak with a human agent or expresses frustration") - Condition that triggers human handover
    - examples string[] (e.g. ["speak to human","talk to agent","need help from person"]) - Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)
    - assignToUserId string (e.g. "user123") - ID of the user to assign the conversation to
    - skipAssignToUser boolean - Whether to skip assigning to a specific user
    - createTask boolean - Whether to create a task when handing over
    - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - finalMessage* string (e.g. "I am transferring you to a human agent who will assist you shortly.") - Final message sent when handing over to human
    - tags string[] (e.g. ["escalated","human-requested"]) - Tags to apply during handover
    - handoverType* string (enum: contactRequest | lackOfInformation | failedToResolveIssue | custom; e.g. "contactRequest") - Type of human handover detection
  - option 6 advancedFollowupDto: object
    - enabled* boolean - Whether advanced followup is enabled
    - scenarioId* string (enum: contactStoppedReplying | contactIsBusy | contactRequested; e.g. "contactIsBusy") - ID of the followup scenario
    - followupSequence* object[] - Sequence of followup actions to perform
      - id* number (e.g. 1) - Unique identifier for this followup step
      - followupTimeUnit* string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Time unit for followup delay
      - followupTime* number (e.g. 2) - Time duration before followup (max: 60 minutes, 24 hours, or 180 days depending on unit)
      - aiEnabledMessage boolean (default: true) - Whether to use AI to generate the followup message
      - triggerWorkflow boolean (default: false) - Whether to trigger a workflow during this followup
      - customMessage string (e.g. "Hi! Just following up on our previous conversation. Do you have any questions?") - Custom message to send (when aiEnabledMessage is false)
      - workflowId string (e.g. "workflow789") - Workflow ID to trigger (when triggerWorkflow is true)
      - contactRequested boolean - Whether contact was requested in this followup
    - followupSettings object - Additional settings for followup behavior
      - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
      - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
      - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups
        - dayOfTheWeek* number (e.g. 1) - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)
        - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
          - startHour* number (e.g. 9) - Start hour (24-hour format)
          - startMinute* number (e.g. 0) - Start minute
          - endHour* number (e.g. 17) - End hour (24-hour format)
          - endMinute* number (e.g. 30) - End minute
      - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business; e.g. "contact") - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location
  - option 7 transferBotDto: object
    - transferBotType* string (enum: Default | Custom; e.g. "Custom") - Type of transfer - Default or Custom
    - transferToBot* string (e.g. "employee789") - ID of the bot/agent to transfer to
    - enabled* boolean - Whether this transfer action is enabled
    - transferBotTriggerCondition string (e.g. "When the user asks to speak with sales or needs pricing information") - Condition that triggers the transfer (required for Custom type)
    - transferBotExamples string[] (e.g. ["talk to sales","pricing information","speak to specialist"]) - Example phrases that trigger transfer (required for Custom type, minimum 2)
  - option 8 CustomApiDetailsDTO: object
    - triggerCondition string (maxLength: 500; e.g. "When the customer asks where their order is or for a delivery date.") - "use this when…" rule shown to the agent. REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged, but sending it blank is rejected.
    - description string (maxLength: 2000; e.g. "Looks up an order in the fulfilment system and returns its status and delivery date.") - Optional description of the API Call action
    - postActionPrompt string (maxLength: 300) - Guidance the agent follows AFTER the call returns (e.g. how to phrase the reply, what not to reveal). REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged (partial merge), but sending it blank is rejected.
    - apiConfig object - The self-contained HTTP definition. Required on CREATE (enforced in the handler). OPTIONAL on UPDATE — omit it to edit just name/description/triggerCondition. When sent on update it is merged ONE LEVEL DEEP over the stored config: top-level keys present replace the stored value, keys absent are kept, and nested objects/arrays (headers, queryParams, bodyTemplate, parameters, outputFields) are replaced whole — send the complete value, not just the entry that changed. Secrets are redacted on read; see `authentication` for how they round-trip.
      - url string (e.g. "https://api.example.com/orders/{{orderId}}") - HTTPS endpoint; supports {{var}}. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored url (apiConfig merges by top-level key).
      - method string (enum: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE; e.g. "GET") - HTTP method used for the call. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored method.
      - headers map<string, string> - Static HTTP headers sent with every call. Secrets belong in `authentication`, not here. On update this object REPLACES the stored headers — send them all, not just the changed one.
      - queryParams map<string, string> - Static query-string parameters appended to the URL.
      - bodyTemplate object - Request body template — object or raw JSON string. Supports {{variable}} placeholders.
      - parameters object - JSON Schema of LLM-supplied params
      - authentication object - Auth config; secrets stored per-instance, write-only
      - timeoutMs number (e.g. 15000) - Per-request timeout in milliseconds (max 60000).
      - retryOnFailure boolean - Retry the call once on a network error or a 5xx. 4xx is never retried.
      - useSimpleRequestBody boolean - Send the body template verbatim as raw JSON instead of building it from the parameter schema.
      - outputFields string[] (e.g. ["data.id","data.status"]) - Dot-paths of the response fields handed back to the agent. Omit to return the whole body; use [] notation for arrays, e.g. `result[].id`.
      - sampleResponse object - Trimmed sample of a real response (editor Test tab). Prompt-only — inlined so the agent knows the response shape; never executed. Secrets are masked on read.

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- data* object | object - Created action details (classic action or customApi API Call action)
  - option 1 ActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the action
    - name* string - Name of the action
    - type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi) - Type of the action
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details* object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, and for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto.
      - option 1 triggerWorkflowDto: object

      - option 3 appointmentBookingDto: object

        - triggerWorkflow* boolean - Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)

        - transferBot* boolean - Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - transferAgent string - Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)
        - rescheduleEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
      - option 4 stopBotDto: object

        - stopBotTriggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers stopping the bot
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped

      - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object

        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)

### Create an Agent
POST /conversation-ai/agents
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/create-agent | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/create-agent.md

Creates a new AI agent for the location. The agent will be created with the specified configuration including name, role, actions, and behavior settings.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateEmployeeDto:
- name* string (e.g. "John Doe") - Name of the agent.
- businessName string (e.g. "Tech Corp") - Name of the business the agent represents.
- mode string (enum: off | suggestive | auto-pilot; default: off; e.g. "auto-pilot") - Mode of operation - OFF, SUGGESTIVE, or AUTO_PILOT
- channels string[] (enum: IG | FB | SMS | WebChat | WhatsApp | Live_Chat | Email; e.g. ["SMS","Live_Chat","WhatsApp"]) - Communication channels the agent can operate on
- isPrimary boolean (default: false) - Indicates if this agent is a primary agent.
- waitTime number (default: 2) - Wait time before agent responds (max 5 for minutes, 300 for seconds)
- waitTimeUnit string (enum: minutes | seconds; default: seconds) - Unit for wait time - SECONDS or MINUTES
- sleepEnabled boolean (default: false; deprecated) - Indicates if sleep functionality is enabled.
- sleepOnManualMessage boolean - Enable sleep when a manual outbound message is sent.
- sleepOnWorkflowMessage boolean - Enable sleep when a workflow outbound message is sent.
- sleepTime number (e.g. 2) - Duration of sleep period (required if sleepEnabled is true). Set to null for indefinite sleep. (max 2880 for minutes, 172800 for seconds, 48 for hours)
- sleepTimeUnit string (enum: hours | minutes | seconds; e.g. "hours") - Unit of sleep time - HOURS, MINUTES, or SECONDS (required if sleepEnabled is true). Set to null for indefinite sleep.
- personality* string (e.g. "Friendly and helpful") - Personality traits of the agent.
- goal* string (e.g. "Assist customers with inquiries.") - The goal of the agent.
- instructions* string (e.g. "Provide  customer service.") - Instructions for the agent.
- fullPrompt string - Complete agent prompt. When set and non-empty, used as the source of truth at generation time instead of personality, goal, and instructions.
- autoPilotMaxMessages number (default: 75) - Maximum number of messages in auto-pilot mode before requiring human intervention. (max: 100, min: 1)

- respondToImages boolean (default: false) - Allow agent to respond to images
- respondToAudio boolean (default: false) - Allow agent to respond to audio

### Remove Action from Agent

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- data* object - Deleted action information
  - id* string - ID of the deleted action
- success* boolean - Success status of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Get Action by ID
GET /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/get-action-by-id | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/get-action-by-id.md

Retrieves detailed information about a specific action using its unique identifier. Returns the action configuration, associated agents, and performance metrics. Supports both classic actions and the `customApi` ("API Call") type.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- actionId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The unique identifier of the action ID Attached to the agent
- agentId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - The unique identifier of the AI agent

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- data* object | object - Action details (classic action or customApi API Call action)
  - option 1 ActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the action
    - name* string - Name of the action
    - type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi) - Type of the action
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details* object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, and for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto.
      - option 1 triggerWorkflowDto: object
        - workflowIds* string[] - Array of workflow IDs to trigger
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers the workflow
        - triggerMessage string - Optional message to send when triggering the workflow
      - option 2 updateContactFieldDto: object
        - contactFieldId* string - ID of the contact field in Contacts Table
        - description* string - Description of the contact field in Contacts Table
        - contactUpdateExamples string[] (default: []) - Contact update examples in Contacts Table. Not required when using standard fields, Monetory or Date Custom fields.
      - option 3 appointmentBookingDto: object
        - actionId string - Optional action ID reference
        - calendarId* string - Calendar ID for appointment booking
        - onlySendLink* boolean - If true, only sends the appointment link without booking
        - triggerWorkflow* boolean - Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - workflowIds string[] - Workflow IDs to trigger after booking (required when triggerWorkflow is true)
        - sleepAfterBooking* boolean - Whether to put the agent to sleep after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Unit for sleep time (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
        - sleepTime number - Sleep duration (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
        - transferBot* boolean - Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - transferAgent string - Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)
        - rescheduleEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
      - option 4 stopBotDto: object
        - stopBotDetectionType* string (enum: Goodbye | Custom) - Type of stop bot detection - Goodbye or Custom
        - stopBotTriggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers stopping the bot
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this action is enabled for the agent
        - stopBotExamples* string[] - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when stopping the bot
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply when stopping the bot
      - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether human handover action is enabled
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers human handover
        - examples string[] - Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)
        - assignToUserId string - ID of the user to assign the conversation to
        - skipAssignToUser boolean - Whether to skip assigning to a specific user
        - createTask boolean - Whether to create a task when handing over
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when handing over to human
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply during handover
        - handoverType* string (enum: contactRequest | lackOfInformation | failedToResolveIssue | custom) - Type of human handover detection
      - option 6 advancedFollowupDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether advanced followup is enabled
        - scenarioId* string (enum: contactStoppedReplying | contactIsBusy | contactRequested) - ID of the followup scenario
        - followupSequence* object[] - Sequence of followup actions to perform
          - id* number - Unique identifier for this followup step
          - followupTimeUnit* string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for followup delay
          - followupTime* number - Time duration before followup (max: 60 minutes, 24 hours, or 180 days depending on unit)
          - aiEnabledMessage boolean (default: true) - Whether to use AI to generate the followup message
          - triggerWorkflow boolean (default: false) - Whether to trigger a workflow during this followup
          - customMessage string - Custom message to send (when aiEnabledMessage is false)
          - workflowId string - Workflow ID to trigger (when triggerWorkflow is true)
          - contactRequested boolean - Whether contact was requested in this followup
        - followupSettings object - Additional settings for followup behavior
          - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
          - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
          - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups
            - dayOfTheWeek* number - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)
            - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
              - startHour* number - Start hour (24-hour format)
              - startMinute* number - Start minute
              - endHour* number - End hour (24-hour format)
              - endMinute* number - End minute
          - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business) - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location
      - option 7 transferBotDto: object
        - transferBotType* string (enum: Default | Custom) - Type of transfer - Default or Custom
        - transferToBot* string - ID of the bot/agent to transfer to
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this transfer action is enabled
        - transferBotTriggerCondition string - Condition that triggers the transfer (required for Custom type)
        - transferBotExamples string[] - Example phrases that trigger transfer (required for Custom type, minimum 2)
  - option 2 CustomApiActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the API Call action
    - name* string - Name of the API Call action
    - type* string (enum: customApi) - Always customApi
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details object - API Call config — description, triggerCondition, and the HTTP definition (secrets redacted on read).
      - triggerCondition string (maxLength: 500) - "use this when…" rule shown to the agent. REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged, but sending it blank is rejected.
      - description string (maxLength: 2000) - Optional description of the API Call action
      - postActionPrompt string (maxLength: 300) - Guidance the agent follows AFTER the call returns (e.g. how to phrase the reply, what not to reveal). REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged (partial merge), but sending it blank is rejected.
      - apiConfig object - The self-contained HTTP definition. Required on CREATE (enforced in the handler). OPTIONAL on UPDATE — omit it to edit just name/description/triggerCondition. When sent on update it is merged ONE LEVEL DEEP over the stored config: top-level keys present replace the stored value, keys absent are kept, and nested objects/arrays (headers, queryParams, bodyTemplate, parameters, outputFields) are replaced whole — send the complete value, not just the entry that changed. Secrets are redacted on read; see `authentication` for how they round-trip.
        - url string - HTTPS endpoint; supports {{var}}. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored url (apiConfig merges by top-level key).
        - method string (enum: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE) - HTTP method used for the call. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored method.
        - headers map<string, string> - Static HTTP headers sent with every call. Secrets belong in `authentication`, not here. On update this object REPLACES the stored headers — send them all, not just the changed one.
        - queryParams map<string, string> - Static query-string parameters appended to the URL.
        - bodyTemplate object - Request body template — object or raw JSON string. Supports {{variable}} placeholders.
        - parameters object - JSON Schema of LLM-supplied params
        - authentication object - Auth config; secrets stored per-instance, write-only
        - timeoutMs number - Per-request timeout in milliseconds (max 60000).
        - retryOnFailure boolean - Retry the call once on a network error or a 5xx. 4xx is never retried.
        - useSimpleRequestBody boolean - Send the body template verbatim as raw JSON instead of building it from the parameter schema.
        - outputFields string[] - Dot-paths of the response fields handed back to the agent. Omit to return the whole body; use [] notation for arrays, e.g. `result[].id`.
        - sampleResponse object - Trimmed sample of a real response (editor Test tab). Prompt-only — inlined so the agent knows the response shape; never executed. Secrets are masked on read.
- success* boolean - Success status of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

        - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
      - option 4 stopBotDto: object

        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)

        - stopBotExamples* string[] - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when stopping the bot

      - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object

        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)

        - tags string[] - Tags to apply during handover

        - followupSequence* object[] - Sequence of followup actions to perform
          - id* number - Unique identifier for this followup step
