          - followupTime* number - Time duration before followup (max: 60 minutes, 24 hours, or 180 days depending on unit)
          - aiEnabledMessage boolean (default: true) - Whether to use AI to generate the followup message
          - triggerWorkflow boolean (default: false) - Whether to trigger a workflow during this followup
          - customMessage string - Custom message to send (when aiEnabledMessage is false)
          - workflowId string - Workflow ID to trigger (when triggerWorkflow is true)
          - contactRequested boolean - Whether contact was requested in this followup
        - followupSettings object - Additional settings for followup behavior
          - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
          - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
          - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups
            - dayOfTheWeek* number - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)
            - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
              - startHour* number - Start hour (24-hour format)
              - startMinute* number - Start minute
              - endHour* number - End hour (24-hour format)
              - endMinute* number - End minute
          - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business) - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location
      - option 7 transferBotDto: object
        - transferBotType* string (enum: Default | Custom) - Type of transfer - Default or Custom
        - transferToBot* string - ID of the bot/agent to transfer to
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this transfer action is enabled
        - transferBotTriggerCondition string - Condition that triggers the transfer (required for Custom type)
        - transferBotExamples string[] - Example phrases that trigger transfer (required for Custom type, minimum 2)
  - option 2 CustomApiActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the API Call action
    - name* string - Name of the API Call action
    - type* string (enum: customApi) - Always customApi
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details object - API Call config — description, triggerCondition, and the HTTP definition (secrets redacted on read).
      - triggerCondition string (maxLength: 500) - "use this when…" rule shown to the agent. REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged, but sending it blank is rejected.
      - description string (maxLength: 2000) - Optional description of the API Call action
      - postActionPrompt string (maxLength: 300) - Guidance the agent follows AFTER the call returns (e.g. how to phrase the reply, what not to reveal). REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged (partial merge), but sending it blank is rejected.
      - apiConfig object - The self-contained HTTP definition. Required on CREATE (enforced in the handler). OPTIONAL on UPDATE — omit it to edit just name/description/triggerCondition. When sent on update it is merged ONE LEVEL DEEP over the stored config: top-level keys present replace the stored value, keys absent are kept, and nested objects/arrays (headers, queryParams, bodyTemplate, parameters, outputFields) are replaced whole — send the complete value, not just the entry that changed. Secrets are redacted on read; see `authentication` for how they round-trip.
        - url string - HTTPS endpoint; supports {{var}}. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored url (apiConfig merges by top-level key).
        - method string (enum: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE) - HTTP method used for the call. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored method.
        - headers map<string, string> - Static HTTP headers sent with every call. Secrets belong in `authentication`, not here. On update this object REPLACES the stored headers — send them all, not just the changed one.
        - queryParams map<string, string> - Static query-string parameters appended to the URL.
        - bodyTemplate object - Request body template — object or raw JSON string. Supports {{variable}} placeholders.
        - parameters object - JSON Schema of LLM-supplied params
        - authentication object - Auth config; secrets stored per-instance, write-only
        - timeoutMs number - Per-request timeout in milliseconds (max 60000).
        - retryOnFailure boolean - Retry the call once on a network error or a 5xx. 4xx is never retried.
        - useSimpleRequestBody boolean - Send the body template verbatim as raw JSON instead of building it from the parameter schema.
        - outputFields string[] - Dot-paths of the response fields handed back to the agent. Omit to return the whole body; use [] notation for arrays, e.g. `result[].id`.
        - sampleResponse object - Trimmed sample of a real response (editor Test tab). Prompt-only — inlined so the agent knows the response shape; never executed. Secrets are masked on read.
- success* boolean - Success status of the request

        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this action is enabled for the agent
        - stopBotExamples* string[] - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when stopping the bot
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply when stopping the bot
      - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether human handover action is enabled
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers human handover
        - examples string[] - Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)
        - assignToUserId string - ID of the user to assign the conversation to
        - skipAssignToUser boolean - Whether to skip assigning to a specific user
        - createTask boolean - Whether to create a task when handing over
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when handing over to human
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply during handover
        - handoverType* string (enum: contactRequest | lackOfInformation | failedToResolveIssue | custom) - Type of human handover detection
      - option 6 advancedFollowupDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether advanced followup is enabled
        - scenarioId* string (enum: contactStoppedReplying | contactIsBusy | contactRequested) - ID of the followup scenario
        - followupSequence* object[] - Sequence of followup actions to perform
          - id* number - Unique identifier for this followup step
          - followupTimeUnit* string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for followup delay
          - followupTime* number - Time duration before followup (max: 60 minutes, 24 hours, or 180 days depending on unit)
          - aiEnabledMessage boolean (default: true) - Whether to use AI to generate the followup message
          - triggerWorkflow boolean (default: false) - Whether to trigger a workflow during this followup
          - customMessage string - Custom message to send (when aiEnabledMessage is false)
          - workflowId string - Workflow ID to trigger (when triggerWorkflow is true)
          - contactRequested boolean - Whether contact was requested in this followup
        - followupSettings object - Additional settings for followup behavior
          - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
          - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
          - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups
            - dayOfTheWeek* number - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)
            - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
              - startHour* number - Start hour (24-hour format)
              - startMinute* number - Start minute
              - endHour* number - End hour (24-hour format)
              - endMinute* number - End minute
          - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business) - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location
      - option 7 transferBotDto: object
        - transferBotType* string (enum: Default | Custom) - Type of transfer - Default or Custom
        - transferToBot* string - ID of the bot/agent to transfer to
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this transfer action is enabled
        - transferBotTriggerCondition string - Condition that triggers the transfer (required for Custom type)
        - transferBotExamples string[] - Example phrases that trigger transfer (required for Custom type, minimum 2)
  - option 2 CustomApiActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the API Call action
    - name* string - Name of the API Call action
    - type* string (enum: customApi) - Always customApi
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details object - API Call config — description, triggerCondition, and the HTTP definition (secrets redacted on read).
      - triggerCondition string (maxLength: 500) - "use this when…" rule shown to the agent. REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged, but sending it blank is rejected.
      - description string (maxLength: 2000) - Optional description of the API Call action
      - postActionPrompt string (maxLength: 300) - Guidance the agent follows AFTER the call returns (e.g. how to phrase the reply, what not to reveal). REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged (partial merge), but sending it blank is rejected.
      - apiConfig object - The self-contained HTTP definition. Required on CREATE (enforced in the handler). OPTIONAL on UPDATE — omit it to edit just name/description/triggerCondition. When sent on update it is merged ONE LEVEL DEEP over the stored config: top-level keys present replace the stored value, keys absent are kept, and nested objects/arrays (headers, queryParams, bodyTemplate, parameters, outputFields) are replaced whole — send the complete value, not just the entry that changed. Secrets are redacted on read; see `authentication` for how they round-trip.
        - url string - HTTPS endpoint; supports {{var}}. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored url (apiConfig merges by top-level key).
        - method string (enum: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE) - HTTP method used for the call. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored method.
        - headers map<string, string> - Static HTTP headers sent with every call. Secrets belong in `authentication`, not here. On update this object REPLACES the stored headers — send them all, not just the changed one.
        - queryParams map<string, string> - Static query-string parameters appended to the URL.
        - bodyTemplate object - Request body template — object or raw JSON string. Supports {{variable}} placeholders.
        - parameters object - JSON Schema of LLM-supplied params
        - authentication object - Auth config; secrets stored per-instance, write-only
        - timeoutMs number - Per-request timeout in milliseconds (max 60000).
        - retryOnFailure boolean - Retry the call once on a network error or a 5xx. 4xx is never retried.
        - useSimpleRequestBody boolean - Send the body template verbatim as raw JSON instead of building it from the parameter schema.
        - outputFields string[] - Dot-paths of the response fields handed back to the agent. Omit to return the whole body; use [] notation for arrays, e.g. `result[].id`.
        - sampleResponse object - Trimmed sample of a real response (editor Test tab). Prompt-only — inlined so the agent knows the response shape; never executed. Secrets are masked on read.
- success* boolean - Success status of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Search Agents
GET /conversation-ai/agents/search
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/search
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/search-agent | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/search-agent.md

Searches for AI agents based on various criteria including name, status, and configuration. Supports advanced filtering and full-text search capabilities.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- startAfter string (e.g. "Exampleee123") - Start after is the agent id to start after, Serving as skip, send empty when first page
- limit number (e.g. 1) - Records per page
- query string (e.g. "booking") - query to search on agent name, must be provided in lowercase

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- agents* object[] - List of agents matching the search criteria.
  - id* string - Unique identifier for the agent.
  - name* string - Name of the agent.
  - businessName string - Name of the business the agent represents.
  - mode* string (enum: off | suggestive | auto-pilot) - Current operating mode of the agent.
  - channels* string[] - Communication channels the agent operates on.
  - waitTime* number - Wait time before agent responds.
  - waitTimeUnit* string (enum: minutes | seconds) - Unit for wait time.
  - sleepEnabled* boolean (deprecated) - Indicates if sleep functionality is enabled.
  - sleepOnManualMessage boolean - Whether the bot sleeps on manual outbound messages.
  - sleepOnWorkflowMessage boolean - Whether the bot sleeps on workflow outbound messages.
  - sleepTime number - Duration of sleep period.
  - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: hours | minutes | seconds) - Unit of sleep time.
  - actions* object[] - List of actions associated with this agent.
  - isPrimary* boolean - Indicates if this agent is a primary agent. (First agent created for a location is primary by default)
  - autoPilotMaxMessages* number - Maximum number of messages in auto-pilot mode before requiring human intervention.
  - goal object - Goal configuration for the agent.
  - knowledgeBaseIds string[] - Array of knowledge base IDs associated with this agent.
  - createdAt* string - Timestamp when the agent was created.
  - updatedAt* string - Timestamp when the agent was last updated.
- totalCount* number - Total number of agents in the location (unfiltered count).
- count* number - Number of agents in the current response (filtered/paginated count).

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Update Action
PUT /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/actions/{actionId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/update-action | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/update-action.md

Updates an existing action's configuration — name, description, trigger condition and behaviour settings. For `customApi` ("API Call") actions `details.apiConfig` is optional: omit it to leave the HTTP definition untouched. When sent, it is merged ONE LEVEL DEEP over the stored config — a top-level key you send replaces the stored value outright, keys you omit are kept. Nested values (`headers`, `queryParams`, `bodyTemplate`, `parameters`, `outputFields`) are replaced whole, so send the complete object rather than just the entry you changed. `authentication` is the exception: secret fields omitted, or returned as the redacted placeholder, keep the stored secret.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- actionId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The unique identifier of the action ID Attached to the agent
- agentId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - The unique identifier of the AI agent

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateActionDTO:
- type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi; e.g. "triggerWorkflow") - Type of action to perform
- name* string (e.g. "Trigger a Workflow") - Name of the action (3-50 characters)
- details* object | object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto, and for CUSTOM_API use CustomApiDetailsDTO (the API Call config).
  - option 1 triggerWorkflowDto: object
    - workflowIds* string[] (e.g. ["workflow123","workflow456"]) - Array of workflow IDs to trigger
    - triggerCondition* string (e.g. "When user requests appointment") - Condition that triggers the workflow
    - triggerMessage string (e.g. "Workflow triggered successfully") - Optional message to send when triggering the workflow
  - option 2 updateContactFieldDto: object
    - contactFieldId* string (e.g. "123") - ID of the contact field in Contacts Table
    - description* string (e.g. "Business Name") - Description of the contact field in Contacts Table
    - contactUpdateExamples string[] (default: []; e.g. ["Example 1"]) - Contact update examples in Contacts Table. Not required when using standard fields, Monetory or Date Custom fields.
  - option 3 appointmentBookingDto: object
    - actionId string (e.g. "action123") - Optional action ID reference
    - calendarId* string (e.g. "calendar123") - Calendar ID for appointment booking
    - onlySendLink* boolean - If true, only sends the appointment link without booking
    - triggerWorkflow* boolean - Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - workflowIds string[] (e.g. ["workflow123"]) - Workflow IDs to trigger after booking (required when triggerWorkflow is true)
    - sleepAfterBooking* boolean - Whether to put the agent to sleep after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Unit for sleep time (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Sleep duration (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
    - transferBot* boolean - Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - transferAgent string (e.g. "employee456") - Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)
    - rescheduleEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
    - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
  - option 4 stopBotDto: object
    - stopBotDetectionType* string (enum: Goodbye | Custom; e.g. "Custom") - Type of stop bot detection - Goodbye or Custom
    - stopBotTriggerCondition* string (e.g. "When the user says they no longer need assistance or want to end the conversation") - Condition that triggers stopping the bot
    - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - enabled* boolean - Whether this action is enabled for the agent
    - stopBotExamples* string[] (e.g. ["goodbye","thank you","no more questions"]) - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
    - finalMessage* string (e.g. "Thank you for contacting us. Have a great day!") - Final message sent when stopping the bot
    - tags string[] (e.g. ["resolved","no-response"]) - Tags to apply when stopping the bot
  - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object
    - enabled* boolean - Whether human handover action is enabled
    - triggerCondition* string (e.g. "When the user requests to speak with a human agent or expresses frustration") - Condition that triggers human handover
    - examples string[] (e.g. ["speak to human","talk to agent","need help from person"]) - Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)
    - assignToUserId string (e.g. "user123") - ID of the user to assign the conversation to
    - skipAssignToUser boolean - Whether to skip assigning to a specific user
    - createTask boolean - Whether to create a task when handing over
    - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover
    - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - sleepTime number (e.g. 24) - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
    - finalMessage* string (e.g. "I am transferring you to a human agent who will assist you shortly.") - Final message sent when handing over to human
    - tags string[] (e.g. ["escalated","human-requested"]) - Tags to apply during handover
    - handoverType* string (enum: contactRequest | lackOfInformation | failedToResolveIssue | custom; e.g. "contactRequest") - Type of human handover detection
  - option 6 advancedFollowupDto: object
    - enabled* boolean - Whether advanced followup is enabled
    - scenarioId* string (enum: contactStoppedReplying | contactIsBusy | contactRequested; e.g. "contactIsBusy") - ID of the followup scenario
    - followupSequence* object[] - Sequence of followup actions to perform
      - id* number (e.g. 1) - Unique identifier for this followup step
      - followupTimeUnit* string (enum: days | hours | minutes; e.g. "hours") - Time unit for followup delay
      - followupTime* number (e.g. 2) - Time duration before followup (max: 60 minutes, 24 hours, or 180 days depending on unit)
      - aiEnabledMessage boolean (default: true) - Whether to use AI to generate the followup message
      - triggerWorkflow boolean (default: false) - Whether to trigger a workflow during this followup
      - customMessage string (e.g. "Hi! Just following up on our previous conversation. Do you have any questions?") - Custom message to send (when aiEnabledMessage is false)
      - workflowId string (e.g. "workflow789") - Workflow ID to trigger (when triggerWorkflow is true)
      - contactRequested boolean - Whether contact was requested in this followup
    - followupSettings object - Additional settings for followup behavior
      - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
      - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
      - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups

        - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
          - startHour* number (e.g. 9) - Start hour (24-hour format)
          - startMinute* number (e.g. 0) - Start minute
          - endHour* number (e.g. 17) - End hour (24-hour format)
          - endMinute* number (e.g. 30) - End minute
      - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business; e.g. "contact") - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location
  - option 7 transferBotDto: object
    - transferBotType* string (enum: Default | Custom; e.g. "Custom") - Type of transfer - Default or Custom

  - option 8 CustomApiDetailsDTO: object

Secrets are redacted on read; see `authentication` for how they round-trip.
      - url string (e.g. "https://api.example.com/orders/{{orderId}}") - HTTPS endpoint; supports {{var}}. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored url (apiConfig merges by top-level key).

Secrets are redacted on read; see `authentication` for how they round-trip.
        - url string - HTTPS endpoint; supports {{var}}. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored url (apiConfig merges by top-level key).
        - method string (enum: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE) - HTTP method used for the call. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored method.
        - headers map<string, string> - Static HTTP headers sent with every call. Secrets belong in `authentication`, not here. On update this object REPLACES the stored headers — send them all, not just the changed one.
        - queryParams map<string, string> - Static query-string parameters appended to the URL.
        - bodyTemplate object - Request body template — object or raw JSON string. Supports {{variable}} placeholders.
        - parameters object - JSON Schema of LLM-supplied params
        - authentication object - Auth config; secrets stored per-instance, write-only
        - timeoutMs number - Per-request timeout in milliseconds (max 60000).
        - retryOnFailure boolean - Retry the call once on a network error or a 5xx. 4xx is never retried.
        - useSimpleRequestBody boolean - Send the body template verbatim as raw JSON instead of building it from the parameter schema.
        - outputFields string[] - Dot-paths of the response fields handed back to the agent. Omit to return the whole body; use [] notation for arrays, e.g. `result[].id`.
        - sampleResponse object - Trimmed sample of a real response (editor Test tab). Prompt-only — inlined so the agent knows the response shape; never executed. Secrets are masked on read.
- success* boolean - Success status of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Update Followup Settings
PATCH /conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/followup-settings
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversation-ai/agents/{agentId}/followup-settings
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/update-followup-settings | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversation-ai/update-followup-settings.md

Update the followup settings for an action

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversation-ai.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- agentId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - The unique identifier of the AI agent

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateFollowupSettingsDTO:
- actionIds* string[] (e.g. ["edxcfghbnjkimd"]) - Array of action IDs to update followup settings for
- followupSettings* object - Followup settings configuration to apply to the specified actions
  - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
  - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
  - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups
    - dayOfTheWeek* number (e.g. 1) - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)
    - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
      - startHour* number (e.g. 9) - Start hour (24-hour format)
      - startMinute* number (e.g. 0) - Start minute
      - endHour* number (e.g. 17) - End hour (24-hour format)
      - endMinute* number (e.g. 30) - End minute
  - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business; e.g. "contact") - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- data* object | object - Updated action details (classic action or customApi API Call action)
  - option 1 ActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the action
    - name* string - Name of the action
    - type* string (enum: triggerWorkflow | updateContactField | appointmentBooking | stopBot | humanHandOver | advancedFollowup | transferBot | customApi) - Type of the action
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details* object | object | object | object | object | object | object - Action-specific details. The structure depends on the action type. For TRIGGER_WORKFLOW use triggerWorkflowDto, for UPDATE_CONTACT_FIELD use updateContactFieldDto, for APPOINTMENT_BOOKING use appointmentBookingDto, for STOP_BOT use stopBotDto, for HUMAN_HAND_OVER use humanHandOverDto, for ADVANCED_FOLLOWUP use advancedFollowupDto, and for TRANSFER_BOT use transferBotDto.
      - option 1 triggerWorkflowDto: object
        - workflowIds* string[] - Array of workflow IDs to trigger
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers the workflow
        - triggerMessage string - Optional message to send when triggering the workflow
      - option 2 updateContactFieldDto: object
        - contactFieldId* string - ID of the contact field in Contacts Table
        - description* string - Description of the contact field in Contacts Table
        - contactUpdateExamples string[] (default: []) - Contact update examples in Contacts Table. Not required when using standard fields, Monetory or Date Custom fields.
      - option 3 appointmentBookingDto: object
        - actionId string - Optional action ID reference
        - calendarId* string - Calendar ID for appointment booking
        - onlySendLink* boolean - If true, only sends the appointment link without booking
        - triggerWorkflow* boolean - Whether to trigger a workflow after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - workflowIds string[] - Workflow IDs to trigger after booking (required when triggerWorkflow is true)
        - sleepAfterBooking* boolean - Whether to put the agent to sleep after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Unit for sleep time (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
        - sleepTime number - Sleep duration (required when sleepAfterBooking is true)
        - transferBot* boolean - Whether to transfer to another agent after booking (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - transferAgent string - Agent ID to transfer to (required when transferBot is true)
        - rescheduleEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment rescheduling (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
        - cancelEnabled* boolean (default: false) - Whether to allow appointment cancellation (cannot be true when onlySendLink is true)
      - option 4 stopBotDto: object
        - stopBotDetectionType* string (enum: Goodbye | Custom) - Type of stop bot detection - Goodbye or Custom
        - stopBotTriggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers stopping the bot
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the bot can be reactivated after being stopped
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this action is enabled for the agent
        - stopBotExamples* string[] - Example phrases that trigger stop bot action (minimum 2 required)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when stopping the bot
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply when stopping the bot
      - option 5 humanHandOverDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether human handover action is enabled
        - triggerCondition* string - Condition that triggers human handover
        - examples string[] - Example phrases that trigger human handover (required when handoverType is custom or contactRequest)
        - assignToUserId string - ID of the user to assign the conversation to
        - skipAssignToUser boolean - Whether to skip assigning to a specific user
        - createTask boolean - Whether to create a task when handing over
        - reactivateEnabled* boolean - Whether the agent can be reactivated after handover
        - sleepTimeUnit string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for reactivation delay (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - sleepTime number - Time duration before reactivation (required when reactivateEnabled is true)
        - finalMessage* string - Final message sent when handing over to human
        - tags string[] - Tags to apply during handover
        - handoverType* string (enum: contactRequest | lackOfInformation | failedToResolveIssue | custom) - Type of human handover detection
      - option 6 advancedFollowupDto: object
        - enabled* boolean - Whether advanced followup is enabled
        - scenarioId* string (enum: contactStoppedReplying | contactIsBusy | contactRequested) - ID of the followup scenario
        - followupSequence* object[] - Sequence of followup actions to perform
          - id* number - Unique identifier for this followup step
          - followupTimeUnit* string (enum: days | hours | minutes) - Time unit for followup delay
          - followupTime* number - Time duration before followup (max: 60 minutes, 24 hours, or 180 days depending on unit)
          - aiEnabledMessage boolean (default: true) - Whether to use AI to generate the followup message
          - triggerWorkflow boolean (default: false) - Whether to trigger a workflow during this followup
          - customMessage string - Custom message to send (when aiEnabledMessage is false)
          - workflowId string - Workflow ID to trigger (when triggerWorkflow is true)
          - contactRequested boolean - Whether contact was requested in this followup
        - followupSettings object - Additional settings for followup behavior
          - dynamicChannelSwitching* boolean (default: true) - Whether to dynamically switch channels for followups
          - followUpHours boolean - Whether to respect working hours for followups
          - workingHours object[] - Working hours configuration for followups
            - dayOfTheWeek* number - Day of the week (0=Sunday, 1=Monday, etc.)
            - intervals object[] - Time intervals for this day
              - startHour* number - Start hour (24-hour format)
              - startMinute* number - Start minute
              - endHour* number - End hour (24-hour format)
              - endMinute* number - End minute
          - timezoneToUse string (enum: contact | business) - Timezone to use for followups, contact or location
      - option 7 transferBotDto: object
        - transferBotType* string (enum: Default | Custom) - Type of transfer - Default or Custom
        - transferToBot* string - ID of the bot/agent to transfer to
        - enabled* boolean - Whether this transfer action is enabled
        - transferBotTriggerCondition string - Condition that triggers the transfer (required for Custom type)
        - transferBotExamples string[] - Example phrases that trigger transfer (required for Custom type, minimum 2)
  - option 2 CustomApiActionDataDTO: object
    - id* string - Unique identifier for the API Call action
    - name* string - Name of the API Call action
    - type* string (enum: customApi) - Always customApi
    - agentId string - Agent ID where the action belongs
    - details object - API Call config — description, triggerCondition, and the HTTP definition (secrets redacted on read).
      - triggerCondition string (maxLength: 500) - "use this when…" rule shown to the agent. REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged, but sending it blank is rejected.
      - description string (maxLength: 2000) - Optional description of the API Call action
      - postActionPrompt string (maxLength: 300) - Guidance the agent follows AFTER the call returns (e.g. how to phrase the reply, what not to reveal). REQUIRED on CREATE (enforced in the handler) to match the builder; on UPDATE it may be OMITTED to leave it unchanged (partial merge), but sending it blank is rejected.
      - apiConfig object - The self-contained HTTP definition. Required on CREATE (enforced in the handler). OPTIONAL on UPDATE — omit it to edit just name/description/triggerCondition. When sent on update it is merged ONE LEVEL DEEP over the stored config: top-level keys present replace the stored value, keys absent are kept, and nested objects/arrays (headers, queryParams, bodyTemplate, parameters, outputFields) are replaced whole — send the complete value, not just the entry that changed. Secrets are redacted on read; see `authentication` for how they round-trip.
        - url string - HTTPS endpoint; supports {{var}}. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored url (apiConfig merges by top-level key).
        - method string (enum: GET | POST | PUT | PATCH | DELETE) - HTTP method used for the call. REQUIRED on create. Optional on update — omit it to keep the stored method.
        - headers map<string, string> - Static HTTP headers sent with every call. Secrets belong in `authentication`, not here. On update this object REPLACES the stored headers — send them all, not just the changed one.
        - queryParams map<string, string> - Static query-string parameters appended to the URL.
        - bodyTemplate object - Request body template — object or raw JSON string. Supports {{variable}} placeholders.
        - parameters object - JSON Schema of LLM-supplied params
        - authentication object - Auth config; secrets stored per-instance, write-only
        - timeoutMs number - Per-request timeout in milliseconds (max 60000).
        - retryOnFailure boolean - Retry the call once on a network error or a 5xx. 4xx is never retried.
        - useSimpleRequestBody boolean - Send the body template verbatim as raw JSON instead of building it from the parameter schema.
        - outputFields string[] - Dot-paths of the response fields handed back to the agent. Omit to return the whole body; use [] notation for arrays, e.g. `result[].id`.
        - sampleResponse object - Trimmed sample of a real response (editor Test tab). Prompt-only — inlined so the agent knows the response shape; never executed. Secrets are masked on read.
- success* boolean - Success status of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Add an inbound message
POST /conversations/messages/inbound
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversations/messages/inbound
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversations/add-an-inbound-message | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversations/add-an-inbound-message.md

Post the necessary fields for the API to add a new inbound message. <br /><br />**Note:** Either `conversationId` or `contactId` is required

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversations/message.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) ProcessMessageBodyDto:
- type* string (enum: SMS | Email | WhatsApp | GMB | IG | FB | Custom | WebChat | Live_Chat | Call; e.g. "SMS") - Message Type
- attachments string[] - Array of attachments
- message string - Message Body
- conversationId string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Conversation Id
- contactId string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Contact Id
- conversationProviderId* string (e.g. "61d6d1f9cdac7612faf80753") - Conversation Provider Id
- html string - HTML Body of Email
- subject string - Subject of the Email
- emailFrom string (e.g. "sender@company.com") - Email address to send from. This field is associated with the contact record and cannot be dynamically changed.
- emailTo string - Recipient email address. This field is associated with the contact record and cannot be dynamically changed.
- emailCc string[] (e.g. ["john1@doe.com","john2@doe.com"]) - List of email address to CC
- emailBcc string[] (e.g. ["john1@doe.com","john2@doe.com"]) - List of email address to BCC
- emailMessageId string - Send the email message id for which this email should be threaded. This is for replying to a specific email
- altId string (e.g. "61d6d1f9cdac7612faf80753") - external mail provider's message id
- direction object (default: outbound; e.g. ["outbound","inbound"]) - Message direction, if required can be set manually, default is outbound
- date string (format: date-time) - Date of the inbound message
- call object - Phone call dialer and receiver information
  - to string (e.g. "+15037081210") - Phone number of the receiver
  - from string (e.g. "+15037081210") - Phone number of the dialer
  - status string (enum: pending | completed | answered | busy | no-answer | failed | canceled | voicemail; e.g. "completed") - Call status

Response 200 (Created the message) application/json:
- success* boolean
- conversationId* string - Conversation ID.
- messageId* string - This is the main Message ID
- message* string
- contactId string
- dateAdded string (format: date-time)
- emailMessageId string

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Export messages by location ID
GET /conversations/messages/export
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversations/messages/export
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversations/export-messages-by-location | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversations/export-messages-by-location.md

Export messages for a specific location with cursor-based pagination support.

**Channel Filtering Behavior:**
- **When channel is omitted:** Returns all non-email message types, including messages that don't belong to any specific channel.
- **When channel=Email:** Returns email messages only.
- **When channel is specified (SMS, Call, WhatsApp, etc.):** Returns messages for that specific channel.

**Limitations:**
- Group Chat and SMS Review Request message types are not supported.
- Cursor validity is 2 minutes from the last request made.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversations/message.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- locationId* string - Location ID to filter messages by
- channel string (enum: Call | SMS | Email | WhatsApp | Instagram | Facebook) - Filter by message channel. Optional - when not provided, all non-email message types will be returned including activity messages (opportunity updates, appointments, etc.). To fetch email messages, you must explicitly set channel=Email.
- limit number (default: 100; min: 10; max: 1000) - Number of messages to return per page
- cursor string (e.g. "a748514c-f49e-4fa8-9954-b53afc78d81d") - Cursor for pagination. Pass the nextCursor from previous response to get next page.
- sortBy string (enum: createdAt | updatedAt; default: createdAt) - Field to sort by
- sortOrder string (enum: asc | desc; default: desc) - Sort order
- conversationId string - Filter messages by conversation ID
- contactId string - Filter messages by contact ID
- startDate string - Start date to filter messages by
- endDate string - End date to filter messages by

Response 200 (List of messages for the location with pagination details.) application/json:
- messages* object[] - Array of messages
  - id* string
  - altId string - Alternative identifier for the message
  - type* number
  - messageType* string (enum: TYPE_CALL | TYPE_SMS | TYPE_EMAIL | TYPE_SMS_REVIEW_REQUEST | TYPE_WEBCHAT | TYPE_SMS_NO_SHOW_REQUEST | TYPE_CAMPAIGN_SMS | TYPE_CAMPAIGN_CALL | TYPE_CAMPAIGN_EMAIL | TYPE_CAMPAIGN_VOICEMAIL | TYPE_FACEBOOK | TYPE_CAMPAIGN_FACEBOOK | TYPE_CAMPAIGN_MANUAL_CALL | TYPE_CAMPAIGN_MANUAL_SMS | TYPE_GMB | TYPE_CAMPAIGN_GMB | TYPE_REVIEW | TYPE_INSTAGRAM | TYPE_WHATSAPP | TYPE_CUSTOM_SMS | TYPE_CUSTOM_EMAIL | TYPE_CUSTOM_PROVIDER_SMS | TYPE_CUSTOM_PROVIDER_EMAIL | TYPE_IVR_CALL | TYPE_ACTIVITY_CONTACT | TYPE_ACTIVITY_INVOICE | TYPE_ACTIVITY_PAYMENT | TYPE_ACTIVITY_OPPORTUNITY | TYPE_LIVE_CHAT | TYPE_LIVE_CHAT_INFO_MESSAGE | TYPE_ACTIVITY_APPOINTMENT | TYPE_FACEBOOK_COMMENT | TYPE_INSTAGRAM_COMMENT | TYPE_CUSTOM_CALL | TYPE_INTERNAL_COMMENT | TYPE_ACTIVITY_EMPLOYEE_ACTION_LOG) - Type of the message as a string
  - locationId* string
  - contactId* string
  - conversationId* string
  - dateAdded* string
  - body string
  - direction* string (enum: inbound | outbound)
  - status string (enum: connected | delivered | failed | opened | pending | read | scheduled | sent | undelivered | clicked | opt_out)
  - contentType* string
  - attachments string[] - An array of attachment URLs. Attachments will be empty for Call and Voicemails, type 1 and 10. Please use get call recording API to fetch call recording and voicemails.
  - meta object
    - callDuration string - Call duration in seconds
    - callStatus string (enum: pending | completed | answered | busy | no-answer | failed | canceled | voicemail) - Call status - can be pending, completed, answered, busy, no-answer, failed, canceled, or voicemail
    - email object - meta will contain email, for message type 3 (email). messageIds is list of all email message ids under the message thread
    - ig object - meta will contain ig, for message type 18 (instagram).
    - fb object - meta will contain fb, for message type 11 (facebook).
  - source string (enum: workflow | bulk_actions | campaign | api | app) - Message source
  - userId string - User Id
  - conversationProviderId string - Conversation Provider Id
  - chatWidgetId string - Chat Widget Id
  - from string - Sender identifier (phone/name). Not returned for email types.
  - to string - Recipient identifier (phone/name). Not returned for email types.
  - error string - Error message if message delivery failed
- nextCursor string - Cursor for fetching next page. Null if no more results.
- total* number - Total number of messages matching the query

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

  - media object - Media to send. Required when `type` is `media`.
    - type* string (enum: image | video | audio | document; e.g. "image") - Kind of media being sent.
    - url* string - Publicly reachable URL of the file. Upload via POST /conversations/messages/upload and use the returned URL.
    - name* string (e.g. "sample.png") - File name shown to the recipient.

- messageId* string - This is the main Message ID

- msg string - Additional response message when sending a workflow message

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Update email message status
PUT /conversations/messages/email/{emailMessageId}/status
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversations/messages/email/{emailMessageId}/status
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversations/update-email-message-status | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversations/update-email-message-status.md

Update delivery events, per-recipient statuses, and the overall message status for an email sent via a custom conversation provider.

**Authorization**
- Requires the `conversations/message.write` OAuth scope.
- The calling OAuth app must own the conversation provider that originally sent the email.
- Attempts to update emails sent via LC Email or Mailgun will return `403 Forbidden`.

**Updatable Fields**
All request body fields are optional. Pass only what you need to update.

**`events`** — Aggregate delivery event counters (integers). Counters are merged into the existing values (not replaced). Setting a counter to `0` is treated as no-op and will **not** reset the stored value.

**`recipients`** — Per-recipient delivery statuses. Each entry maps a recipient email address to a `MessageStatus` value. Use `failReason` to capture bounce or rejection details when the status is `failed`.

**`status`** — The overall message status. Accepts any `MessageStatus` enum value.

**Event Inference**
The API automatically infers related events to maintain data consistency:
- **`clicked`, `complained`, `unsubscribed`, or `replied`** → implies `opened` (set to 1 if not already provided and open tracking is enabled) and `delivered` (set to 1).
- **`opened`** → implies `delivered` (set to 1 if not provided).
- **`delivered`, `permanent_fail`, or `temporary_fail`** → implies `accepted` (set to 1 if not provided).

**Timestamps**
The API automatically records server-side timestamps on first occurrence for `delivered`, `opened`, and `clicked` events. Subsequent updates to these counters do not overwrite the original timestamp.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversations/message.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- emailMessageId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Email Message Id

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateEmailMessageStatusDto:
- events object - Aggregate delivery event counters. Counters are merged into existing values. The API automatically infers related events (e.g., reporting `clicked` will also set `opened` and `delivered` if not already present). See the endpoint description for the full inference rules.
  - delivered integer (e.g. 1) - Number of successful deliveries — the recipient mail server accepted the message. Automatically inferred (set to 1) when `opened`, `clicked`, `complained`, `unsubscribed`, or `replied` events are reported.
  - opened integer (e.g. 3) - Number of unique open events (typically tracked via a tracking pixel). Automatically inferred (set to 1) when `clicked`, `complained`, `unsubscribed`, or `replied` events are reported, provided open tracking is enabled on the email.
  - clicked integer (e.g. 1) - Number of link click events within the email body. Triggers automatic inference of both `opened` and `delivered`.
  - replied integer (e.g. 1) - Number of reply events. Triggers automatic inference of both `opened` (if open tracking is enabled) and `delivered`.
  - failed integer (e.g. 0) - Total number of delivery failures (includes both permanent and temporary). For more granular failure tracking, use `permanent_fail` and `temporary_fail` instead.
  - accepted integer (e.g. 1) - Number of messages accepted by the receiving mail server for delivery. Automatically inferred (set to 1) when `delivered`, `permanent_fail`, or `temporary_fail` events are reported.
  - rejected integer (e.g. 0) - Number of messages rejected outright by the receiving mail server (before acceptance).
  - unsubscribed integer (e.g. 0) - Number of unsubscribe events triggered by the recipient. Triggers automatic inference of `opened` and `delivered`.
  - complained integer (e.g. 0) - Number of spam complaint events (e.g., recipient marked the email as spam). Triggers automatic inference of `opened` and `delivered`.
  - stored integer (e.g. 0) - Number of messages stored by the email service provider (ESP-specific event).
- recipients object[] - Per-recipient delivery statuses. Each entry maps a recipient email address to a delivery status. Entries are upserted — if a recipient already has a status, it will be overwritten with the new value.
  - emailId* string (e.g. "john@doe.com") - The recipient's email address. This is used as the key to store and update the per-recipient status. Must match one of the original recipients of the email.
  - status* string (enum: pending | scheduled | sent | delivered | read | undelivered | connected | failed | opened | clicked; e.g. "delivered") - The delivery status for this specific recipient. Common values for status updates: `delivered` (successfully delivered), `failed` (delivery failed — provide `failReason`), `opened` (recipient opened the email), `clicked` (recipient clicked a link).
  - failReason string (e.g. "Mailbox not found") - Human-readable reason for the delivery failure. Only applicable when `status` is `failed`. Examples: "Mailbox not found", "Quota exceeded", "Blocked by recipient server".
- status* string (enum: pending | scheduled | sent | delivered | read | undelivered | connected | failed | opened | clicked; e.g. "delivered") - The overall status of the email message. Required on every request. For emails with multiple recipients, consider using the `recipients` array for granular tracking and this field for the aggregate status.

Response 200 (Email message status updated successfully) application/json:
- success* boolean - Whether the status update was persisted successfully.
- message* string - Human-readable result message.

Errors: 400, 401, 403 (400, 401: see Common error responses)
Response 403 (Forbidden - status updates are only supported for custom conversation provider emails) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string

### Upload file attachments
POST /conversations/messages/upload
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/conversations/messages/upload
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversations/upload-file-attachments | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/conversations/upload-file-attachments.md

Post the necessary fields for the API to upload files. The files need to be a buffer with the key "fileAttachment". <br /><br /> <b>Note:</b> One of conversationId or contactId must be provided. <br /><br /> <b>File Size Limits:</b> <ul><li>Maximum file size: 5 MB</li><li>Maximum files per upload: 5</li></ul> <br /> <b>Allowed file types:</b> <br /><br /> <b>Images:</b> JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF, SVG, HEIC, AI <br /><br /> <b>Videos:</b> MP4, MPEG, 3GP <br /><br /> <b>Audio:</b> MP3, WAV, WAVE, AIFF, AIF, AIFC, GSM, ULAW, OGG, AAC, M4A, AMR <br /><br /> <b>Documents:</b> PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT, CSV, XLS, XLSX, PPT, PPTX, ODT <br /><br /> <b>Archives:</b> ZIP, RAR <br /><br /> <b>Other:</b> VCF, VCARD (contact files), ICS (calendar files) <br /><br /> The API will return an object with the URLs <br /><br /> <b>Secure attachments:</b> Set <code>isSecureAttachment</code> to <code>true</code> to upload the file as a secure attachment. This is currently supported for the <b>email channel only</b>; support for the remaining conversation channels is coming. <br /><br /> A secure attachment is returned with a <code>/files/d/{slug}</code> URL that is publicly accessible for one hour after upload. After that window the attachment becomes private — to render, download, or retry access, extract the <code>{slug}</code> from the returned URL and call <a href="https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/files/get-file-by-slug" target="_blank"><code>GET /files/d/{slug}</code></a> with a bearer token carrying the <code>files.readonly</code> OAuth scope, which returns a short-lived signed download URL. A file uploaded without this flag keeps its existing permanently accessible URL. <br /><br /> <b>Note:</b> From 30 November 2026 every file uploaded through this endpoint is stored as a secure attachment, and the <code>isSecureAttachment</code> field is ignored.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: conversations/message.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (multipart/form-data) UploadFilesDto:
- conversationId string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Conversation Id
- contactId string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Contact Id
- workflowId string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Workflow Id
- campaignId string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Campaign Id
- locationId* string
- attachmentUrls* string[]
- isSecureAttachment string (default: false) - Set to true to upload the file as a secure attachment. Defaults to false. Currently supported for the email channel only; support for the remaining conversation channels is coming. A secure attachment URL is publicly accessible for one hour after upload, after which the file must be fetched with GET /files/d/{slug} using the files.readonly OAuth scope. Considered only until 30 November 2026; from that date every upload is stored as a secure attachment and this field is ignored.

Response 200 (Uploaded the file successfully) application/json:
- uploadedFiles* object

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 413, 415 (400, 401: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Not Found - Conversation id, contact id, workflow id or campaign id not found) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 413 (Payload Too Large) application/json:
- status* number (enum: 400 | 404 | 413 | 415) - HTTP Status code of the request
- message* string - Error message of the request
Response 415 (Unsupported Media Type) application/json:
- status* number (enum: 400 | 404 | 413 | 415) - HTTP Status code of the request
- message* string - Error message of the request

Create a countdown timer for the access token's location

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: countdown-timer/timer.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCountdownTimerPublicV1BodyDto:
- name* string (e.g. "Flash Sale Timer") - Timer name
- timerType* string (enum: fixed | dynamic | recurring; e.g. "fixed") - Timer type
- templateId* string (e.g. "minimal") - Template ID from the list-templates endpoint
- endDate string (e.g. "2026-04-01T00:00:00.000Z") - End date in ISO 8601 format. Required for fixed timers.
- timezone string (e.g. "America/New_York") - Valid IANA timezone identifier
- timerDuration object - Timer duration. Required for dynamic and recurring timers.
  - days* number (e.g. 0) - Number of days
  - hours* number (e.g. 2) - Number of hours
  - minutes* number (e.g. 30) - Number of minutes
  - seconds* number (e.g. 0) - Number of seconds
- waitTime object - Wait time between recurring loops
  - days* number (e.g. 0) - Number of days
  - hours* number (e.g. 2) - Number of hours
  - minutes* number (e.g. 30) - Number of minutes
  - seconds* number (e.g. 0) - Number of seconds
- designMeta* object - Design metadata for timer appearance. Get defaults from the templates endpoint and customize as needed.
  - counterFontSize number (e.g. 50) - Counter font size in px
  - counterFontFamily string (e.g. "inter") - Counter font family
  - counterFontWeight string (e.g. "normal") - Counter font weight
  - labelFontSize number (e.g. 15) - Label font size in px
  - labelFontFamily string (e.g. "inter") - Label font family
  - labelFontWeight string (e.g. "normal") - Label font weight
  - digitColor string (e.g. "#a21043") - Digit color (hex)
  - labelColor string (e.g. "#a21043") - Label color (hex)
  - separatorColor string (e.g. "#feccd6") - Separator color (hex)
  - backgroundColor string (e.g. "#ffffff") - Background color (hex)
  - circleBorderColor string (e.g. "#000000") - Circle border color (hex)
  - circleFillColor string (e.g. "#ffffff") - Circle fill color (hex)
  - boxColor string (e.g. "#101828") - Box color (hex)
  - borderColor string (e.g. "#101828") - Border color (hex)
  - isTransparent boolean - Transparent background
  - hasSeparator boolean - Show separator between units

    - bottom number (e.g. 16) - Bottom padding in px
    - left number (e.g. 16) - Left padding in px

  - previewUrl string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/cdn/countdown-timer/templates/minimal/preview.png") - Preview image URL from template

- expiryImageLink string (e.g. "https://example.com/expiry.png") - Image to show when timer expires
- bgImageLink string (e.g. "https://example.com/bg.png") - Background image for timer

  - endTime* string (e.g. "17:00") - End time for dynamic timer
  - trigger* string (enum: sent | opened | whatsapp_sent | whatsapp_opened; e.g. "sent") - Trigger event

Response 200 (Timer updated) application/json:
- id* string - Timer ID
- name* string - Timer name
- templateId string - Template ID
- locationId* string - Location ID
- status* string (enum: active | draft | archived) - Timer status
- timerType* string (enum: fixed | dynamic | recurring) - Timer type
- endDate string - End date (ISO 8601)
- startDate string - Start date (ISO 8601)
- timezone string - Timezone
- designMeta object - Design metadata for timer appearance
  - counterFontSize number - Counter font size in px
  - counterFontFamily string - Counter font family
  - counterFontWeight string - Counter font weight
  - labelFontSize number - Label font size in px
  - labelFontFamily string - Label font family
  - labelFontWeight string - Label font weight
  - digitColor string - Digit color (hex)
  - labelColor string - Label color (hex)
  - separatorColor string - Separator color (hex)
  - backgroundColor string - Background color (hex)
  - circleBorderColor string - Circle border color (hex)
  - circleFillColor string - Circle fill color (hex)
  - boxColor string - Box color (hex)
  - borderColor string - Border color (hex)
  - isTransparent boolean - Transparent background
  - hasSeparator boolean - Show separator between units
  - hasFillingBorder boolean - Show filling border animation
  - hasBoxColor boolean - Show box color behind digits
  - labels object - Unit labels
    - days string - Label for days unit
    - hours string - Label for hours unit
    - minutes string - Label for minutes unit
    - seconds string - Label for seconds unit
  - unitVisibility object - Unit visibility toggles
    - days boolean - Show days
    - hours boolean - Show hours
    - minutes boolean - Show minutes
    - seconds boolean - Show seconds
  - borderRadius number - Border radius in px
  - hasPadding boolean - Enable padding
  - padding object - Padding values
    - top number - Top padding in px
    - bottom number - Bottom padding in px
    - left number - Left padding in px
    - right number - Right padding in px
  - previewUrl string - Preview image URL from template
- timerDuration object - Timer duration
- links object - Timer links
- trackingLink string - Tracking link URL
- hasLink boolean - Whether timer has an active link
- previewUrl string - Preview image URL
- thumbnailUrl string - Thumbnail image URL

### Create Category
POST /courses/products/{productId}/categories
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/courses/products/{productId}/categories
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/courses/create-category | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/courses/create-category.md

Create a category in a course. Requires a Location token with courses.write. Accepts category columns (title required). locationId, userId, productId, originId are not accepted.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: courses.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- productId* string (format: uuid; minLength: 1; e.g. "a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890") - Product id

Query parameters:
- locationId* string (minLength: 1; e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location id or sub-account id is required.

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCategoryDto:
- description string (nullable)
- parentCategory string (nullable)
- visibility string (enum: published | draft | locked | drip)
- posterImage string (nullable)
- sequenceNo number (e.g. 1)
- dripDays number (e.g. 0)
- metadata object (nullable)
  - dripUnit string (enum: days | hours)
  - dripDate string (nullable) - ISO-8601 date. Used when visibility is drip.
- commentPermission string (enum: hidden | enabled | locked; nullable) - Optional. Null is treated as omitted (membership defaults to enabled on create).
- lockedBy string (nullable) - Published lesson id in this product that unlocks this category. Must not be a draft lesson, a lesson in a draft module, or a lesson inside this category. When visibility is locked, provide lockedBy, lockedByCategory, or both.
- lockedByCategory string (nullable) - Published category id in this product that unlocks this category. Must not be this category or a draft module. When visibility is locked, provide lockedBy, lockedByCategory, or both.
- title* string (e.g. "Module 1") - Category title

Response 201 (Created) application/json:
- id* string - Category id
- title* string
- description* string (nullable)
- parentCategory* string (nullable)
- visibility* string (enum: published | draft | locked | drip)
- posterImage* string (nullable)
- sequenceNo* number
- dripDays* number
- metadata* object (nullable)
  - dripUnit string (enum: days | hours)
  - dripDate string (nullable) - ISO-8601 date. Used when visibility is drip.
- commentPermission* string (enum: hidden | enabled | locked)
- lockedBy* string (nullable)
- lockedByCategory* string (nullable)
- createdAt* string
- updatedAt* string

Response 500 (Internal Server Error): no body

Grant a contact access to a membership offer. Requires a Location token with courses.write. Send Version: v3. Uses POST smart-list/user with source public_api (not the queued attach-offer-user path). - offerId* string (e.g. "c3d4e5f6-7890-4123-cdef-123456789012") - Membership offer id

Response 200 (Success) application/json:
- alreadyEnrolled* boolean - true when the contact already has a purchase for this offer in the location
- contactId* string
- offerId* string

Response 201 (Created) application/json:
- alreadyEnrolled* boolean - true when the contact already has a purchase for this offer in the location

- offerId* string

## Service: custom-fields (Custom Fields V2 API)

Custom fields are data points that allow you to capture and store specific information tailored to your business requirements. You can create fields across field types like text, numeric, selection options and special fields like date/time or signature

### Create Custom Field
POST /custom-fields/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/custom-fields/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/custom-fields/create-custom-field | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/custom-fields/create-custom-field.md

<div>
<p> Create Custom Field </p> 
 </div> 
 :::info
 Only supports Custom Objects and Company (Business) today. Will be extended to other Standard Objects in the future.
 :::

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: locations/customFields.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCustomFieldsDTO:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id
- name string (e.g. "Name") - Field name
- description string - Description of the field
- placeholder string - Placeholder text for the field
- showInForms* boolean - Whether the field should be shown in forms
- options object[] - Options for the field (Optional, valid only for SINGLE_OPTIONS, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, RADIO, CHECKBOX, TEXTBOX_LIST type)
  - key* string - Key of the option (Included in Create and Response, excluded in Update)
  - label* string - Value of the option
  - url string - URL associated with the option (Optional, valid only for RADIO type)
- acceptedFormats string (enum: .pdf | .docx | .doc | .jpg | .jpeg | .png | .gif | .csv | .xlsx | .xls | all) - Allowed file formats for uploads. Options include: .pdf, .docx, .doc, .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .csv, .xlsx, .xls, all
- dataType* string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | NUMERICAL | PHONE | MONETORY | CHECKBOX | SINGLE_OPTIONS | MULTIPLE_OPTIONS | DATE | TEXTBOX_LIST | FILE_UPLOAD | RADIO | EMAIL) - Type of field that you are trying to create
- fieldKey* string (e.g. "custom_object.pet.name") - Field key. For Custom Object it's formatted as "custom_object.{objectKey}.{fieldKey}". "custom_object" is a fixed prefix, "{objectKey}" is your custom object's identifier, and "{fieldKey}" is the unique field name within that object. Example: "custom_object.pet.name" for a "name" field in a "pet" custom object.
- objectKey* string (e.g. "custom_object.pet") - The key for your custom object. This key uniquely identifies the custom object. Example: "custom_object.pet" for a custom object related to pets.
- maxFileLimit number (e.g. 2) - Maximum file limit for uploads. Applicable only for fields with a data type of FILE_UPLOAD.
- allowCustomOption boolean - Determines if users can add a custom option value different from the predefined options in records for RADIO type fields. A custom value added in one record does not automatically become an option and will not appear as an option for other records.
- parentId* string - ID of the parent folder

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- field object
  - locationId* string - Location Id
  - name string - Field name
  - description string - Description of the field
  - placeholder string - Placeholder text for the field
  - showInForms* boolean - Whether the field should be shown in forms
  - options object[] - Options for the field (Optional, valid only for SINGLE_OPTIONS, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, RADIO, CHECKBOX, TEXTBOX_LIST type)
    - key* string - Key of the option (Included in Create and Response, excluded in Update)
    - label* string - Value of the option
    - url string - URL associated with the option (Optional, valid only for RADIO type)
  - acceptedFormats string (enum: .pdf | .docx | .doc | .jpg | .jpeg | .png | .gif | .csv | .xlsx | .xls | all) - Allowed file formats for uploads. Options include: .pdf, .docx, .doc, .jpg, .jpeg, .png, .gif, .csv, .xlsx, .xls, all
  - id* string - Unique identifier of the object
  - objectKey* string - The key for your custom / standard object. This key uniquely identifies the custom object. Example: "custom_object.pet" for a custom object related to pets.
  - dataType* string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | NUMERICAL | PHONE | MONETORY | CHECKBOX | SINGLE_OPTIONS | MULTIPLE_OPTIONS | DATE | TEXTBOX_LIST | FILE_UPLOAD | RADIO) - Type of field that you are trying to create
  - parentId* string - ID of the parent folder
  - fieldKey* string - Field key. For Custom Object it's formatted as "custom_object.{objectKey}.{fieldKey}". "custom_object" is a fixed prefix, "{objectKey}" is your custom object's identifier, and "{fieldName}" is the unique field name within that object. Example: "custom_object.pet.name" for a "name" field in a "pet" custom object.
  - allowCustomOption boolean - Determines if users can add a custom option value different from the predefined options in records for RADIO type fields. A custom value added in one record does not automatically become an option and will not appear as an option for other records.
  - maxFileLimit number - Maximum file limit for uploads
  - dateAdded* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was added
  - dateUpdated* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was last updated

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Schedule Campaign
POST /emails/locations/{locationId}/campaigns/emails/{campaignId}/schedule
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/emails/locations/{locationId}/campaigns/emails/{campaignId}/schedule
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/emails/schedule-campaign | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/emails/schedule-campaign.md

Schedule or start an email campaign. The campaign must be in draft, cancelled, or paused status.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: emails/campaigns.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location ID
- campaignId* string (e.g. "67f15c2ae99226d5bcccb8f3") - Campaign ID

Request body (required) (application/json) ScheduleCampaignPublicV2BodyDto:
- scheduleType* string (enum: immediate | scheduled | batch | rss | smart_send; e.g. "immediate") - How to schedule the campaign
- timeZone* string (e.g. "America/New_York") - IANA timezone
- userId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439099") - ID of the user performing this action
- userName string (e.g. "John Doe") - Name of the user performing this action
- emailMeta* object - Email subject, sender, and content metadata
  - subject* string (e.g. "Our February Newsletter") - Email subject line
  - fromName* string (e.g. "John Doe") - Sender display name
  - fromEmail* string (e.g. "john@example.com") - Sender email address
  - replyToAddress string (e.g. "reply@example.com") - Reply-to email address
  - previewText string (e.g. "Check out our latest news") - Preview text shown in inbox after subject
  - attachments string[] (e.g. ["https://example.com/file.pdf"]) - Attachment download URLs
- recipients* object - Who receives the email. Must provide either contactIds or filter.
  - type* string (enum: contact | tag | segment; e.g. "contact") - Recipient selection type
  - contactIds string[] (e.g. ["contactId1","contactId2"]) - Contact IDs to send to. Required when type is contact.
  - tagIds string[] (e.g. ["tagId1","tagId2"]) - Tag IDs to filter recipients by. Required when type is tag.
  - segment string (enum: engaged_last_7_days | engaged_last_30_days | engaged_last_60_days | engaged_last_5_campaigns | unengaged_last_5_campaigns; e.g. "engaged_last_7_days") - Segment type for pre-built segments. Required when type is segment.
  - freezeList boolean (default: true) - Freeze the contact list at schedule time — new matching contacts will not be added later
- sendDays string[] (enum: Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun; e.g. ["Mon","Tue","Wed","Thu","Fri","Sat","Sun"]) - Days of the week to allow sending. Used for batch and RSS scheduleTypes.
- scheduleConfig object - Schedule configuration for immediate, scheduled, batch, and smart_send types. Required when scheduleType is not rss.
  - sendAt string (e.g. "2026-04-01 09:00 AM") - Date/time to send. Required for scheduled, batch, and smart_send. Ignored for immediate.
  - batch object - Batch/drip configuration. Required when scheduleType is batch. Ignored otherwise.
    - batchSize* number (e.g. 100) - Number of contacts to process per batch
    - interval* number (e.g. 2) - Delay between batches
    - intervalUnit* string (enum: minutes | hours | days; e.g. "hours") - Unit for the interval
    - skipDays string[] (enum: Mon | Tue | Wed | Thu | Fri | Sat | Sun; e.g. ["Sat","Sun"]) - Days to skip sending
    - windowStart string (e.g. "09:00 AM") - Earliest time to send batches
    - windowEnd string (e.g. "05:00 PM") - Latest time to send batches
  - tracking object - Click and UTM tracking options
    - clickTracking boolean - Enable click tracking on links
    - utmTracking boolean - Enable UTM parameters on links
  - resend object - Auto-resend to contacts who did not open
    - enabled boolean - Enable resend to contacts who did not open
    - waitHours number (e.g. 12) - Hours to wait before resending. Required when enabled is true.
    - subject string (e.g. "Did you miss this?") - Override subject line for the resend email
  - emailPreferenceId string (e.g. "preference-type-id") - Email preference type ID for categorizing this campaign
- rssConfig object - RSS feed configuration. Required when scheduleType is rss.
  - name* string (e.g. "Weekly Digest") - RSS schedule name
  - rssFeedURL* string (e.g. "https://example.com/rss") - RSS feed URL
  - repeatAfter* string (enum: every_day | every_week | every_month; e.g. "every_day") - How often to check the feed
  - repeatAfterTime* string (e.g. "09:00 AM") - Time of day to execute
  - rssFeedLimit number (e.g. 10) - Max number of RSS items per email
  - startAtDay string (enum: Monday | Tuesday | Wednesday | Thursday | Friday | Saturday | Sunday; e.g. "Monday") - Day of week for weekly RSS
  - startAtMonthDay string (e.g. "15") - Day of month for monthly RSS
  - firstExecutionDate string (e.g. "2026-04-01 10:00:00") - Override first execution date/time
- abTestConfig object - A/B test configuration. Can be combined with any scheduleType except rss.
  - testType* string (enum: emailContent | subjectLine; e.g. "subjectLine") - What is being tested
  - testDuration* number (e.g. 3600) - Seconds to run the test before picking a winner
  - variationCount* number (e.g. 2) - Number of variations
  - testSize* number (e.g. 30) - Percentage of contacts in the test group (0-100)
  - winningCriteria* string (enum: openRate | clickRate; e.g. "openRate") - How to pick the winner
  - variations* object[] - A/B test variations
    - subject string (e.g. "Subject A") - Subject line for this variation
    - documentId string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - Template/document ID for this variation

Response 201 (Success) application/json:
- campaignId* string - Campaign ID
- sourceId* string (nullable) - Source ID for fetching campaign statistics
- traceId string - Trace ID of the request

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 422 (400, 401, 403, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Not Found) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code for not found
- message string - Error message describing the not found failure
- error string - Error type identifier
Response 409 (Conflict - Campaign is already scheduled or being processed): no body
