Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices/schedule.write
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices/schedule.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- scheduleId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Schedule Id

Request body (required) (application/json) ScheduleInvoiceScheduleDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - location Id / company Id based on altType
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- liveMode* boolean
- autoPayment object - auto-payment configuration
  - enable* boolean
  - type string
  - paymentMethodId string
  - customerId string
  - card object
    - brand* string
    - last4* string
  - usBankAccount object
    - bank_name* string
    - last4* string
  - sepaDirectDebit object
    - bank_code* string
    - last4* string
    - branch_code* string
  - bacsDirectDebit object
    - sort_code* string
    - last4* string
  - becsDirectDebit object
    - bsb_number* string
    - last4* string
  - cardId string
  - provider object

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - Schedule Id
- status* object - Schedule Status
- liveMode* boolean - Live Mode
- altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- name* string - Name of the invoice
- schedule object
  - executeAt string
  - rrule object
    - intervalType* string (enum: yearly | monthly | weekly | daily | hourly | minutely | secondly)
    - interval* number
    - startDate* string - Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format
    - startTime string - Start time in HH:mm:ss format
    - endDate string - End date in YYYY-MM-DD format
    - endTime string - End time in HH:mm:ss format
    - dayOfMonth number - -1, 1, 2, 3, ..., 27, 28
    - dayOfWeek string (enum: mo | tu | we | th | fr | sa | su)
    - numOfWeek number - -1, 1, 2, 3, 4
    - monthOfYear string (enum: jan | feb | mar | apr | may | jun | jul | aug | sep | oct | nov | dec)
    - count number - Max number of task executions
    - daysBefore number - Execute task number of days before
    - useStartAsPrimaryUserAccepted boolean - Start as primary user accepted date
    - endType string - End type like after, by, count
- invoices* object[] - List of invoices
  - _id* string - Invoice Id
  - status* string (enum: draft | sent | payment_processing | paid | void | partially_paid) - Invoice Status
  - liveMode* boolean - Live Mode
  - amountPaid* number - Amount Paid
  - altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
  - altType* string (enum: location)
  - name* string - Name of the invoice
  - businessDetails* object - Business Details
  - invoiceNumber* number - Invoice Number
  - currency* string - Currency
  - contactDetails* object - Contact Details
  - issueDate* string - Issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format
  - dueDate* string - Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format
  - discount object - Discount
  - invoiceItems* string[] - Invoice Items
  - total* number - Total Amount
  - title* string - Title
  - amountDue* number - Total Amount Due
  - createdAt* string - created at
  - updatedAt* string - updated at
  - automaticTaxesEnabled boolean - Automatic taxes enabled for the Invoice
  - automaticTaxesCalculated boolean - Is Automatic taxes calculated for the Invoice items
  - paymentSchedule object - split invoice into payment schedule summing up to full invoice amount
- businessDetails* object - Business Details
  - logoUrl string - Business Logo URL
  - name string - Business Name
  - phoneNo string - Business Phone Number
  - address object - Business Address
    - addressLine1 string - Address Line 1
    - addressLine2 string - Address Line 2
    - city string - City
    - state string - State
    - countryCode string - Country Code
    - postalCode string - Postal Code
  - website string - Business Website Link
  - customValues string[] - Custom Values
- currency* string - Currency
- contactDetails* object - Contact Details
  - id* string - Contact ID
  - name* string - Contact Name
  - phoneNo* string - Contact Phone Number
  - email* string - Contact Email
  - additionalEmails object[] - Secondary email addresses for the contact to be saved
    - email* string
  - companyName string - Contact Company Name
  - address object
    - addressLine1 string - Address Line 1
    - addressLine2 string - Address Line 2
    - city string - City
    - state string - State
    - countryCode string - Country Code
    - postalCode string - Postal Code
  - customFields string[] - Custom Values
- discount object - Discount
  - value number (default: 0) - Discount Value
  - type* string (enum: percentage | fixed; default: percentage) - Discount type
  - validOnProductIds string[] - Product Ids on which discount is applicable
- items* string[] - Invoice Items
- total* number - Total Amount

### Send Estimate

API to send estimate by estimate id

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices/estimate.write
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices/estimate.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- estimateId* string (e.g. "5f9d6d8b1b2d2c001f2d9e4b") - Estimate Id

Request body (required) (application/json) SendEstimateDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- action* string (enum: sms_and_email | send_manually | email | sms)
- liveMode* boolean - livemode for estimate
- userId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Please ensure that the UserId corresponds to an authorized personnel, either by an employee ID or agency ID, to access this location. This account will serve as the primary channel for all future communications and updates.
- sentFrom object - sender details for invoice, valid only if invoice is not sent manually
  - fromName string (e.g. "Alex") - Sender name to be used while sending email notification
  - fromEmail string (e.g. "alex@example.com") - Email id to be used while sending email notification
- estimateName string (e.g. "Estimate") - estimate name

Response 201 (Created) application/json:
- altId* string - Location Id or Agency Id
- altType* string (enum: location)
- _id* string - Unique identifier
- liveMode* boolean - Indicates if it is in live mode
- deleted* boolean - Indicates if deleted
- name* string - Name
- currency* string - Currency code
- businessDetails* object - Business details associated with the estimate
- items* any[][] - An array of items
- discount* object - Discount details for the estimate template
  - value number (default: 0) - Discount Value
  - type* string (enum: percentage | fixed; default: percentage) - Discount type
  - validOnProductIds string[] - Product Ids on which discount is applicable
- title string - Title
- estimateNumberPrefix string - Estimate number prefix
- attachments object[] - Attachments
  - id* string - Id of the file selected
  - name* string - Name of the file
  - url* string - URL of the file
  - type* string - Type of the file
  - size* number - Size of the file
- updatedBy string - User Id of who last updated
- total* number - Total amount
- createdAt* string (format: date-time) - Timestamp when created
- updatedAt* string (format: date-time) - Timestamp when last updated
- __v* number - Version number
- automaticTaxesEnabled* boolean - Indicates if automatic taxes are enabled for this estimate
- termsNotes string - Terms and conditions for the estimate, supports HTML markup
- companyId* string - Company identifier associated with the estimate
- contactDetails* object - Contact details for the estimate
- issueDate* string (format: date-time) - Date when the estimate was issued
- expiryDate* string (format: date-time) - Date when the estimate expires
- sentBy string - User who sent the estimate
- automaticTaxesCalculated* boolean - Indicates if automatic taxes were calculated
- meta* object - Additional metadata associated with the estimate
- estimateActionHistory* string[] - History of actions taken on the estimate
- sentTo* object - Recipient details for the estimate
- frequencySettings* object - Frequency settings for recurring estimates
  - enabled* boolean - enabled for the frequency settings
  - schedule* object - schedule setting for the estimate
    - executeAt string
    - rrule object
      - intervalType* string (enum: yearly | monthly | weekly | daily | hourly | minutely | secondly)
      - interval* number
      - startDate* string - Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format
      - startTime string - Start time in HH:mm:ss format
      - endDate string - End date in YYYY-MM-DD format
      - endTime string - End time in HH:mm:ss format
      - dayOfMonth number - -1, 1, 2, 3, ..., 27, 28
      - dayOfWeek string (enum: mo | tu | we | th | fr | sa | su)
      - numOfWeek number - -1, 1, 2, 3, 4
      - monthOfYear string (enum: jan | feb | mar | apr | may | jun | jul | aug | sep | oct | nov | dec)
      - count number - Max number of task executions
      - daysBefore number - Execute task number of days before
      - useStartAsPrimaryUserAccepted boolean - Start as primary user accepted date
      - endType string - End type like after, by, count
- lastVisitedAt* string (format: date-time) - Timestamp when the estimate was last visited
- totalamountInUSD* number - Total amount in USD
- autoInvoice object - Auto-invoice settings for the estimate
- traceId* string - Trace ID for logging and debugging

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Create & Send

API to create or update a text2pay invoice

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: invoices.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) Text2PayDto:
- altId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - location Id / company Id based on altType
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- name* string (e.g. "New Invoice") - Invoice Name
- currency* string (e.g. "USD") - Currency code
- items* object[] - An array of items for the invoice.
  - name* string (e.g. "ABC Product") - Invoice Item Name
  - description string (e.g. "ABC Corp.") - Invoice descriptions
  - productId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Product Id
  - priceId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Price Id
  - currency* string (e.g. "USD") - Currency
  - amount* number (e.g. 999) - Product amount
  - qty* number (e.g. 1) - Product Quantity
  - taxes object[] - Tax
    - _id* string
    - name* string
    - rate* number
    - calculation string (enum: exclusive)
    - description string
    - taxId string
  - automaticTaxCategoryId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Tax category id for calculating automatic tax
  - isSetupFeeItem boolean - Setupfee item, only created when 1st invoice of recurring schedule is generated
  - type string (enum: one_time | recurring; e.g. "one_time") - Price type of the item
  - taxInclusive boolean (default: false) - true if item amount is tax inclusive
- termsNotes string (e.g. "<p>This is a default terms.</p>") - Terms notes, Also supports HTML markups
- title string (e.g. "INVOICE") - Title for the invoice
- contactDetails* object - Contact information to send the invoice to
  - id* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Contact ID
  - name* string (e.g. "Alex") - Contact Name
  - phoneNo* string (e.g. "+1234567890") - Contact Phone Number
  - email* string (e.g. "alex@example.com") - Contact Email
  - additionalEmails object[] - Secondary email addresses for the contact to be saved
    - email* string (e.g. "alex@example.com")
  - companyName string (e.g. "ABC Corp.") - Contact Company Name
  - address object
    - addressLine1 string (e.g. "9931 Beechwood") - Address Line 1
    - addressLine2 string (e.g. "Beechwood") - Address Line 2
    - city string (e.g. "St. Houston") - City
    - state string (e.g. "TX") - State
    - countryCode string (e.g. "US") - Country Code
    - postalCode string (e.g. "559-6993") - Postal Code
  - customFields string[] - Custom Values
- invoiceNumber string (e.g. "1001") - Invoice Number
- issueDate* string (e.g. "2023-01-01") - Issue date in YYYY-MM-DD format
- dueDate string (e.g. "2023-01-14") - Due date in YYYY-MM-DD format
- sentTo* object
  - email* string[] (e.g. ["alex@example.com"]) - Email Address
  - emailCc string[] (e.g. ["alex@example.com"]) - cc to be kept in any sent out emails
  - emailBcc string[] (e.g. ["alex@example.com"]) - bcc to be kept in any sent out emails
  - phoneNo string[] (e.g. ["+1-214-559-6993"]) - Contact Phone Number
- liveMode* boolean
- automaticTaxesEnabled boolean - Automatic taxes enabled for the Invoice
- paymentSchedule object - split invoice into payment schedule summing up to full invoice amount
  - type* string (enum: fixed | percentage; e.g. "percentage") - Payment schedule type
  - schedules* string[] - payment schedule item
- lateFeesConfiguration object - late fees configuration
  - enable* boolean - Enable late fees
  - value* number (e.g. 10) - Late Fees Value
  - type* string (enum: fixed | percentage; e.g. "fixed") - Late Fees Type
  - frequency* object - Late Fees Frequency
    - intervalCount* number (e.g. 10) - Late fees interval count
    - interval* string (enum: minute | hour | day | week | month | one_time; e.g. "day") - Late fees interval
  - grace object - Late Fees Grace
    - intervalCount* number (e.g. 10) - Late fees grace interval count
    - interval* string (enum: day; e.g. "day") - Late fees grace interval
  - maxLateFees object - Max late fees payable
    - type* string (enum: fixed; e.g. "fixed")
    - value* number (e.g. "10") - Max late fees to pay
- tipsConfiguration object - tips configuration for the invoice
  - tipsPercentage* string[] (e.g. [5,10,15]) - Percentage of tips allowed
  - tipsEnabled* boolean - Tips enabled status
- invoiceNumberPrefix string (e.g. "INV-") - prefix for invoice number
- paymentMethods object - Payment Methods for Invoices
  - stripe* object - Payment Method
    - enableBankDebitOnly* boolean - Enable Bank Debit Only
- attachments object[] - attachments for the invoice
  - id* string (e.g. "6241712be68f7a98102ba272") - Id of the file selected
  - name* string (e.g. "Electronics.pdf") - Name of the file
  - url* string (e.g. "https://example.com/digital-delivery") - URL of the file
  - type* string - Type of the file
  - size* number (e.g. 10000) - Size of the file
- miscellaneousCharges object - miscellaneous charges for the invoice
  - charges* any[][] - charges for the processing fee
  - collectedMiscellaneousCharges number (e.g. 10) - collected miscellaneous charges
  - paidCharges object[] - paid miscellaneous charges
    - name* string (e.g. "Processing Fee") - name of the processing fee
    - charge* number (e.g. 10) - charge for the processing fee
    - amount* number (e.g. 10) - amount of the processing fee
    - _id* string (e.g. "673d01d7d547648a8dab6211") - id of the processing fee
- id string - id of invoice to update. If skipped, a new invoice will be created
- includeTermsNote boolean - include terms & notes with receipts
- action* string (enum: draft | send; e.g. "draft") - create invoice in draft mode or send mode
- userId* string - id of user generating invoice
- discount object
  - value number (default: 0; e.g. 10) - Discount Value
  - type* string (enum: percentage | fixed; default: percentage) - Discount type
  - validOnProductIds string[] (e.g. "[ '6579751d56f60276e5bd4154' ]") - Product Ids on which discount is applicable
- businessDetails object
  - logoUrl string (e.g. "https://example.com/logo.png") - Business Logo URL
  - name string (e.g. "ABC Corp.") - Business Name
  - phoneNo string (e.g. "+1-214-559-6993") - Business Phone Number
  - address object (e.g. "9931 Beechwood, TX") - Business Address
    - addressLine1 string (e.g. "9931 Beechwood") - Address Line 1
    - addressLine2 string (e.g. "Beechwood") - Address Line 2
    - city string (e.g. "St. Houston") - City

    - countryCode string (e.g. "US") - Country Code

  - customValues string[] - Custom Values

### Start crawling and discover pages for training
POST /knowledge-bases/crawler

Starts a website crawl that discovers pages for later AI training.
WHEN TO USE: use this when you need to scan a site before training; use trainDiscoveredUrls to ingest selected pages; use getCrawlingStatusForLatestOperation to poll progress.

Headers:

- Version: v3 (required)

- url* string (e.g. "https://kubernetes.io/tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Website URL as string
- option* string (enum: Exact | Path | Domain; e.g. "Exact") - Mode as string
- knowledgeBaseId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - knowledge base ID as string
- preSelectedUrls string[] (e.g. ["https://example.com/page-1","https://example.com/page-2"]) - Pre-selected URLs from sitemap preview — when provided, only these URLs are crawled

Response 201 (Crawling and discovery started successfully) application/json:

- status* string (enum: Pending | Processing | Successful | Failed | Existing | Restricted | Cancelled | Aborted | Training; read-only) - Current status of the website discovery operation

### Create Custom Field
POST /locations/{locationId}/customFields
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/locations/{locationId}/customFields
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/create-custom-field | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/locations/create-custom-field.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: locations/customFields.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCustomFieldsDTO:
- name* string (e.g. "Custom Field")
- dataType* string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | NUMERICAL | PHONE | MONETORY | CHECKBOX | SINGLE_OPTIONS | MULTIPLE_OPTIONS | FLOAT | TIME | DATE | TEXTBOX_LIST | FILE_UPLOAD | SIGNATURE | RADIO | URL | DATE_TIME | USER | RICH_TEXT; e.g. "TEXT") - Data type of the custom field. URL, USER, TIME, DATE_TIME and RICH_TEXT are Labs-only for now.
- placeholder string (e.g. "Placeholder Text")
- acceptedFormat string[] (e.g. [".pdf",".docx",".jpeg"])
- isMultipleFile boolean
- maxNumberOfFiles number (e.g. 2)
- textBoxListOptions (object | object)[]
  - option 1 textBoxListOptionsSchema: object
    - label string (e.g. "First")
    - prefillValue string (e.g. "")
  - option 2 textBoxListOptionsSchema: object
    - label string (e.g. "First")
    - prefillValue string (e.g. "")
- position number (default: 0)
- model string (enum: contact | opportunity; e.g. "opportunity") - Model of the custom field you want to create
- urlValidation object - URL validation rules. Required when dataType is URL.
  - mode string (enum: allow_all | allow_only | block; e.g. "allow_all") - allow_all: any url. allow_only: only allowedDomains. block: anything but blockedDomains.
  - allowedDomains string[] (e.g. ["example.com"]) - Domains accepted when mode is allow_only
  - blockedDomains string[] (e.g. []) - Domains rejected when mode is block
- dateTimeValidation object - Date/time validation. Required for TIME and DATE_TIME; optional for DATE when using validation rules.
  - mode string (enum: any | future_only | past_only | range; e.g. "any") - any: no restriction. future_only: value must be in future. past_only: value must be in past. range: value within rangeMin-rangeMax.
  - bufferDays number (e.g. 2) - For future_only: minimum days from today before a date is selectable
  - rollingDays number (e.g. 30) - For future_only: rolling window in days from today (e.g. 30 = next 30 days). Mutually exclusive with bufferDays.
  - rangeMin string (e.g. "2026-01-01") - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
  - rangeMax string (e.g. "2026-12-31") - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
  - daysAllowed number[] (e.g. [1,2,3,4,5]) - Days of week 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Works alongside future_only, past_only, or range modes.
  - inputType string (enum: date_only | time_only | date_and_time; e.g. "date_and_time") - For DATE_TIME fields: collect date only, time only, or both (defaults per product if omitted).
- userFieldConfig object - User field options. Required when dataType is USER. multiSelect cannot be changed after create.
  - multiSelect boolean - Single or multi-select; cannot change after create
- optionDisplayType string (enum: TEXT_ONLY | TEXT_WITH_ICON | TEXT_WITH_IMAGE; e.g. "TEXT_WITH_IMAGE") - Option rendering mode for RADIO / CHECKBOX. One of TEXT_ONLY, TEXT_WITH_ICON, TEXT_WITH_IMAGE. Defaults to TEXT_ONLY.

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- customField object
  - id string
  - name string
  - fieldKey string
  - placeholder string
  - dataType string (enum: TEXT | LARGE_TEXT | NUMERICAL | PHONE | MONETORY | CHECKBOX | SINGLE_OPTIONS | MULTIPLE_OPTIONS | FLOAT | TIME | DATE | TEXTBOX_LIST | FILE_UPLOAD | SIGNATURE | RADIO | URL | DATE_TIME | USER | RICH_TEXT) - Data type of the custom field. URL, USER, TIME, DATE_TIME and RICH_TEXT are Labs-only for now.
  - position number
  - picklistOptions string[]
  - picklistImageOptions string[]
  - isAllowedCustomOption boolean
  - isMultiFileAllowed boolean
  - maxFileLimit number
  - locationId string
  - model string (enum: contact | opportunity) - Model of the custom field
  - urlValidation object - URL validation (URL fields). Labs-only as of now.
    - mode string (enum: allow_all | allow_only | block) - allow_all: any url. allow_only: only allowedDomains. block: anything but blockedDomains.
    - allowedDomains string[] - Domains accepted when mode is allow_only
    - blockedDomains string[] - Domains rejected when mode is block
  - dateTimeValidation object - Date/time validation (DATE, TIME, DATE_TIME). DATE_TIME and TIME are Labs-only as of now.
    - mode string (enum: any | future_only | past_only | range) - any: no restriction. future_only: value must be in future. past_only: value must be in past. range: value within rangeMin-rangeMax.
    - bufferDays number - For future_only: minimum days from today before a date is selectable
    - rollingDays number - For future_only: rolling window in days from today (e.g. 30 = next 30 days). Mutually exclusive with bufferDays.
    - rangeMin string - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
    - rangeMax string - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
    - daysAllowed number[] - Days of week 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Works alongside future_only, past_only, or range modes.
    - inputType string (enum: date_only | time_only | date_and_time) - For DATE_TIME fields: collect date only, time only, or both (defaults per product if omitted).
  - userFieldConfig object - User field config (USER fields). Labs-only as of now.
    - multiSelect boolean - Single or multi-select; cannot change after create
  - optionDisplayType string (enum: TEXT_ONLY | TEXT_WITH_ICON | TEXT_WITH_IMAGE) - Option rendering mode for RADIO / CHECKBOX. One of TEXT_ONLY, TEXT_WITH_ICON, TEXT_WITH_IMAGE.

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

    - rangeMax string - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string

  - allowedDomains string[] (e.g. ["example.com"]) - Domains accepted when mode is allow_only
  - blockedDomains string[] (e.g. []) - Domains rejected when mode is block
- dateTimeValidation object - When provided, replaces date/time validation rules (DATE, TIME, DATE_TIME fields only).
  - mode string (enum: any | future_only | past_only | range; e.g. "any") - any: no restriction. future_only: value must be in future. past_only: value must be in past. range: value within rangeMin-rangeMax.
  - bufferDays number (e.g. 2) - For future_only: minimum days from today before a date is selectable
  - rollingDays number (e.g. 30) - For future_only: rolling window in days from today (e.g. 30 = next 30 days). Mutually exclusive with bufferDays.
  - rangeMin string (e.g. "2026-01-01") - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
  - rangeMax string (e.g. "2026-12-31") - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string
  - daysAllowed number[] (e.g. [1,2,3,4,5]) - Days of week 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Works alongside future_only, past_only, or range modes.
  - inputType string (enum: date_only | time_only | date_and_time; e.g. "date_and_time") - For DATE_TIME fields: collect date only, time only, or both (defaults per product if omitted).
- userFieldConfig object - When provided, updates user field options except multiSelect (immutable after create).
  - multiSelect boolean - Single or multi-select; cannot change after create
- optionDisplayType string (enum: TEXT_ONLY | TEXT_WITH_ICON | TEXT_WITH_IMAGE; e.g. "TEXT_WITH_IMAGE") - When provided, updates the option rendering mode (RADIO / CHECKBOX only). One of TEXT_ONLY, TEXT_WITH_ICON, TEXT_WITH_IMAGE.

URL, USER, TIME, DATE_TIME and RICH_TEXT are Labs-only for now.

  - picklistImageOptions string[]

    - blockedDomains string[] - Domains rejected when mode is block

    - mode string (enum: any | future_only | past_only | range) - any: no restriction. future_only: value must be in future. past_only: value must be in past. range: value within rangeMin-rangeMax.
    - bufferDays number - For future_only: minimum days from today before a date is selectable
    - rollingDays number - For future_only: rolling window in days from today (e.g. 30 = next 30 days). Mutually exclusive with bufferDays.
    - rangeMin string - Required when mode is range. ISO date or datetime string

    - daysAllowed number[] - Days of week 0=Sunday..6=Saturday. Works alongside future_only, past_only, or range modes.
    - inputType string (enum: date_only | time_only | date_and_time) - For DATE_TIME fields: collect date only, time only, or both (defaults per product if omitted).

### Create a new wallet charge
POST /marketplace/billing/charges
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/marketplace/billing/charges
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/charge | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/charge.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: charges.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) RaiseChargeBodyDTO:
- appId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - App ID of the App
- meterId* string (e.g. "680b97022b4a34420f5f9b93") - Billing Meter ID (you can find this on your app's pricing page)
- eventId* string (e.g. "evt_abc123") - Event ID / Transaction ID on your server's side. This will help you maintain the reference of the event/transaction on your end that you charged the customer for.
- userId string (e.g. "user_abc123") - User ID
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - ID of the Sub-Account to be charged
- companyId* string (e.g. "company_abc123") - ID of the Agency the Sub-account belongs to
- description* string (e.g. "Charge for sending 10 SMS messages") - Description of the charge
- price number (e.g. 0.01) - Price per unit to charge
- units* number (e.g. 10) - Number of units to charge
- eventTime string (e.g. "2025-03-26T00:00:000Z") - The timestamp when the event/transaction was performed. If blank, the billing timestamp will be set as the event time. ISO8601 Format.

Response 201 (Charge created successfully) application/json:
- success boolean - Indicates whether the charge was created successfully
- chargeId string - Unique identifier of the created charge

Errors: 400, 422 (422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Bad request) application/json:
- message string - Error message describing the bad request
- statusCode number - HTTP status code

### Get all wallet charges
GET /marketplace/billing/charges
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/marketplace/billing/charges
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/get-charges | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/get-charges.md

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: charges.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- meterId string (e.g. "680b97022b4a34420f5f9b93") - Billing Meter ID (you can find this on your app's pricing page on the developer portal)
- eventId string (e.g. "evt_abc123") - Event ID / Transaction ID
- userId string (e.g. "user_abc123") - Filter results by User ID that your server passed via API when the charge was created
- startDate string (e.g. "2025-03-26") - Filter results AFTER a specific date. Use this in combination with endDate to filter results in a specific time window.
- endDate string (e.g. "2025-03-26") - Filter results BEFORE a specific date. Use this in combination with startDate to filter results in a specific time window.
- skip number (e.g. 0) - Number of records to skip
- limit number (e.g. 10) - Maximum number of records to return

Response 200 (Returns list of wallet charges) application/json:
- charges object[] - List of wallet charges
  - refunded boolean - Value is 'true' if the charge has subsequently been refunded.
  - currency string - Currency of the transaction. We currently support USD only.
  - appId string - App ID
  - meterId string - Billing Meter ID (you can find this on your app's pricing page)
  - chargeId string - Charge ID
  - entityType string - Indicates who was charged? Currently, we support charges for 'location' only
  - entityId string - If the entityType is Location, entityld would be locationld.
  - amountCharged number - Total amount charged
  - pricePerUnit number - Price per unit for the charge
  - transactionType string - This can be one of two values - 'charge' or 'refund'
  - units number - Number of units that the sub-account was charged for
  - meta object - meta object contains details that were sent while creating the charge via the API - eventID, description, eventTime, userld
  - createdAt string (format: date-time) - Timestamp when the charge was created in our system
  - updatedAt string (format: date-time) - Timestamp when the charge was last updated in our system
- count number (deprecated) - Total number of charges
- pagination object - Pagination metadata for the charges list
  - total number - Total number of charges
  - skip number - Number of records to skip
  - limit number - Maximum number of records to return

Errors: 422 (422: see Common error responses)

### Migrate external authentication connection
POST /marketplace/external-auth/migration
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/marketplace/external-auth/migration
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/migrate-connection | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/migrate-connection.md

Migrates an external authentication connection credentials (basic or oauth2) for a specific app and location. This endpoint validates the app configuration, stores credentials safely in CRM's native encrypted storage. With this the lifecycle of the token is managed by CRM.

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: marketplace-external-auth-migration.write
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: marketplace-external-auth-migration.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) MigrateConnectionDto:
- type* string (enum: oauth2 | basic; e.g. "oauth2") - Type of authentication - basic or oauth2
- locationId* string (e.g. "location_12345") - Location ID
- appId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439011") - App ID
- appVersionId* string (e.g. "507f1f77bcf86cd799439012") - App Version ID
- accountId* string (e.g. "my-connection-identifier") - Connection identifier
- apiKey string (e.g. "sk_test_1234567890") - API Key (supported when type is basic)
- basicCredentials object - Basic auth credentials as key/value pairs (supported when type is basic). Keys are validated against the app version externalAuthConfig.fields.
- accessToken string (e.g. "ya29.a0AfH6SMBx...") - Access token (required when type is oauth2)
- refreshToken string (e.g. "1//0gHq5F...") - Refresh token. Omit only when the provider issues long-lived, non-refreshable tokens (e.g. TikTok Marketing API, ClickUp) and therefore never returns one. Callers are responsible for supplying it whenever their app has a refresh endpoint configured: the migration stores exactly what it is given and replaces any previously stored secret, so omitting a refresh token the connection needs will leave it unable to refresh once the access token expires. Must be a non-empty string when supplied — null is rejected.
- expiryIn number (e.g. 3600000) - Access token expiry time in milliseconds (optional for oauth2)
- expiryAt number (e.g. 1735689600000) - Timestamp for access token expiry (optional for oauth2)
- scopes string[] (e.g. ["contacts.readonly","contacts.write"]) - OAuth2 scopes (optional for oauth2)
- displayName string (e.g. "My Connection Display Name") - Display name for the connection (optional, defaults to accountId)
- email string (e.g. "user@example.com") - Account email metadata for the migrated connection
- identitySource string (enum: provider | manual; e.g. "manual") - Source of the account identity metadata
- isDefault boolean - Whether this is the default connection for the location (optional, defaults to false)

Response 201 (Connection migrated successfully) application/json:
- success* boolean - Indicates if the migration was successful
- identifier* string - Unique identifier for the migrated connection
- message string - Message describing the result

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 500
Response 400 (Bad request - invalid input or auth type mismatch) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
Response 401 (Unauthorized - invalid or missing token) application/json:
- statusCode number
- message string
- error string
Response 404 (App not found): no body
Response 500 (Internal server error) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code
- message string - Error message describing the internal server error

### Uninstall an application
DELETE /marketplace/app/{appId}/installations
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/marketplace/app/{appId}/installations
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/uninstall-application | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/marketplace/uninstall-application.md

- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: oauth.write

Request body (required) (application/json) DeleteIntegrationBodyDto:
- companyId string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - The company id from which the application is to be uninstalled. If you pass agency token, then companyId is required. It will uninstall application from agency as well as all sub-accounts.
- locationId string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - The location id from which the application is to be uninstalled. If you pass location token, then locationId is required. It will uninstall application from that location only.

- parentId string (e.g. "64af50c42d567a3b4f5989e0") - ID of the parent folder (optional)

Response 200 (Returns the newly created folder object) application/json:
- altId* string - Location identifier that owns this folder
- altType* string (enum: location) - Type of entity that owns the folder
- name* string - Name of the folder
- parentId string - ID of the parent folder (null for root folders)
- type* string - Type of the object (always 'folder' for folders)
- deleted boolean - Whether the folder has been deleted
- pendingUpload boolean - Whether there are pending uploads to this folder
- category string - Primary category of content stored in the folder
- subCategory string - Sub-category of content stored in the folder
- isPrivate boolean - Whether the folder is private and not publicly accessible
- relocatedFolder boolean - Whether the folder has been moved from its original location
- migrationCompleted boolean - Whether the data migration process has been completed for this folder
- appFolder boolean - Whether this is a system-generated application folder
- isEssential boolean - Whether the folder is essential and should not be deleted
- status string - Current status of the folder
- lastUpdatedBy string - ID of the user who last updated the folder

## Service: oauth (OAuth 2.0 v3)

Documentation for OAuth 2.0 API

**API Version v3**

All APIs available via `/v3` route prefix with AIP-compliant responses.

### Get Access Token
POST /oauth/token
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/oauth/token
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/oauth/get-access-token | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/oauth/get-access-token.md

Use Access Tokens to access CRM resources on behalf of an authenticated location/company.

Auth: none (no security requirement declared; send no Authorization header)

Headers:
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) GetAccessTokenBodyDto:
- client_id* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The ID provided by CRM for your integration
- client_secret* string (e.g. "ab12dc0ae1234a7898f9ff06d4f69gh") - The client secret provided by CRM for your integration
- grant_type* string (enum: authorization_code | refresh_token | client_credentials; e.g. "authorization_code") - The OAuth2 grant type — authorization_code, refresh_token, or client_credentials
- code string (e.g. "ab12dc0ae1234a7898f9ff06d4f69gh") - The authorization code received from the authorization endpoint (required for authorization_code grant)
- refresh_token string (e.g. "xy34dc0ae1234a4858f9ff06d4f66ba") - The refresh token used to obtain a new access token (required for refresh_token grant)
- user_type string (enum: Company | Location; e.g. "Location") - The type of token to be requested
- redirect_uri string (e.g. "https://myapp.com/oauth/callback/crm") - The redirect URI for your application

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- access_token string - The OAuth2 access token
- token_type string - The token type (always Bearer)
- expires_in number - Time in seconds until the access token expires
- refresh_token string - The OAuth2 refresh token used to obtain a new access token
- scope string - Space-separated list of scopes the access token has access to
- userType string - The user type associated with the token (Location or Company)
- locationId string - Location ID - Present only for Sub-Account Access Token
- companyId string - Company ID
- approvedLocations string[] - Approved locations to generate location access token
- userId* string - USER ID - Represent user id of person who performed installation
- planId string - Plan Id of the subscribed plan in paid apps.
- isBulkInstallation boolean - Indicates whether the installation was performed as a bulk installation
- installToFutureLocations boolean - Boolean to control if user wants app to be automatically installed to future locations (only for company tokens)
- approveAllLocations boolean - Boolean indicating if user approved all locations during bulk installation (only for company tokens)

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

### Get Location where app is installed
GET /oauth/installed-locations
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/oauth/installed-locations
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/oauth/get-installed-location | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/oauth/get-installed-location.md

This API allows you fetch location where app is installed upon

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token only (Private Integration Tokens are not accepted). Scopes: oauth.readonly

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Query parameters:
- pageSize number (default: 20) - Max items per page (1-100). Replaces legacy `limit` parameter per AIP-158.
- pageToken string (e.g. "eyJza2lwIjoyMH0") - Opaque token returned in a previous response to fetch the next page. Replaces legacy `skip` parameter per AIP-158.
- query string (maxLength: 100; e.g. "location name") - Literal installed-location name search. Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored.
- isInstalled boolean - Filters out location which are installed for specified app under the specified company
- restrictToUserLocations boolean - When true, restricts the list to locations the current user has access to (for restricted agency admins and account admins). When false or omitted, no user-based filter is applied for installed list; for backward compatibility, install list (isInstalled=false) is still filtered by user when this param is omitted.
- companyId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Parameter to search by the companyId
- appId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Parameter to search by the appId
- versionId string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - VersionId of the app
- onTrial boolean - Filters out locations which are installed for specified app in trial mode
- planId string - Filters out location which are installed for specified app under the specified planId
- locationId string (e.g. "1245") - locationId

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- items* object[] - List of locations with their installation status for the requested app
  - _id* string - Location ID
  - name* string - Name of the location
  - address* string - Address linked to location
  - isInstalled boolean - Check if the requested app is installed for following location
  - versionId string - Version ID of the installed app version for this location
  - installedAt string (format: date-time) - Timestamp when the app was installed on this location
- pagination* object - Pagination metadata (AIP-158)
  - totalRecords number - Total number of records matching the query across all pages
  - hasNextPage* boolean - True when a next page is available
  - hasPrevPage* boolean - True when a previous page is available
  - nextPageToken string - Opaque token to fetch the next page
  - prevPageToken string - Opaque token to fetch the previous page
  - currentPageSize* number - Number of items returned in the current page
  - estimatedTotalRecords number - Estimated total records; present when exact total is unknown
- metadata object - Query metadata (filters and sort applied)
  - filterApplied object - Filters that were applied to the query
  - sortApplied object - Sort order that was applied to the query
- installToFutureLocations boolean - Boolean to control if user wants app to be automatically installed to future locations

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 422 (401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 400 (Invalid argument (AIP error envelope)) application/json:
- error* object - AIP-compliant error envelope
  - code* string - Machine-readable error code (see AipErrorCode enum in @platform-core/aip-framework)
  - message* string - Human-readable error message
  - details object - Additional error context (field name, identifier, etc.)
  - resolution string - Suggested resolution for the caller
Response 404 (App not found (AIP error envelope)) application/json:
- error* object - AIP-compliant error envelope
  - code* string - Machine-readable error code (see AipErrorCode enum in @platform-core/aip-framework)
  - message* string - Human-readable error message
  - details object - Additional error context (field name, identifier, etc.)
  - resolution string - Suggested resolution for the caller

## Service: objects (CUSTOM_OBJECTS API)

Custom objects are completely customizable objects that allow you to store and manage information tailored to your unique business needs. With custom objects, you can create custom fields, establish relationships, and integrate them into workflows, providing flexibility beyond standard objects like Contacts, Opportunities or Companies.

### Create Custom Object
POST /objects/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/objects/
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/create-custom-object-schema | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/objects/create-custom-object-schema.md

Allows you to create a custom object schema. To understand objects and records, please have a look at the documentation here : https://doc.clickup.com/8631005/d/h/87cpx-277156/93bf0c2e23177b0

Auth: Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: objects/schema.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCustomObjectSchemaDTO:
- labels* object - This is what your custom object will be called. These labels will be used to display your custom object on the UI
  - singular* string (e.g. "Pet") - Singular name of the custom object
  - plural* string (e.g. "Pets") - Plural name of the custom object
- key* string (e.g. "custom_objects.pet") - key that would be used to refer the Custom Object internally (lowercase + underscore_separated). 'custom_objects.' would be added as prefix by default
- description string (e.g. "These are non vaccinated pets") - Pet Object`s description
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Location Id
- primaryDisplayPropertyDetails* object - Primary property which will be displayed on the record page
  - key* string (e.g. "custom_objects.pet.name") - key that would be used to refer the custom field internally (lowercase + underscore_separated). 'custom_objects.{{objectKey}}' would be added as prefix by default is not passed
  - name* string (e.g. "Pet name") - Name of the Primary property name which will be displayed on the record page
  - dataType* string (e.g. "TEXT") - Primary property data Type (it can either be TEXT or NUMERICAL type)

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- object object
  - id* string - id of the custom / standard object schema
  - standard* boolean - false in case of custom objects and true in case of standard objects like contacts and opportunities
  - key* string - key that would be used to refer the custom / standard Object internally (lowercase + underscore_separated). For custom objects, 'custom_objects.' would be added as prefix by default
  - labels* object - This is what your custom / standard object will be called. These labels will be used to display your custom object on the UI
    - singular* string - Singular name of the custom object
    - plural* string - Plural name of the custom object
  - description string - Custom / Standard Object Descriptions for example , Pet Object`s description
  - locationId* string - location's id
  - primaryDisplayProperty* string - Primary property for the custom / standard Object. This would be used as primary data when rendering the UI. 'custom_objects.{{object_key}} or business.{{object_key}} (for company)' would be added as prefix by default for all the custom / standard objects
  - dateAdded* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was added
  - dateUpdated* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was last updated
  - type object - Object`s Type

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

POST /notes/
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/notes/

  - dateAdded* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was added

    - plural* string - Plural name of the custom object

  - dateUpdated* string (format: date-time) - Date and time when the object was last updated

- cache* boolean - Is the response served from cache
- fields object[]
  - locationId* string - Location Id
  - name string - Field name
  - description string - Description of the field
  - placeholder string - Placeholder text for the field
  - showInForms* boolean - Whether the field should be shown in forms
  - options object[] - Options for the field (Optional, valid only for SINGLE_OPTIONS, MULTIPLE_OPTIONS, RADIO, CHECKBOX, TEXTBOX_LIST type)
    - key* string - Key of the option (Included in Create and Response, excluded in Update)
    - label* string - Value of the option
    - url string - URL associated with the option (Optional, valid only for RADIO type)

  - parentId* string - ID of the parent folder
  - fieldKey* string - Field key. For Custom Object it's formatted as "custom_object.{objectKey}.{fieldKey}". "custom_object" is a fixed prefix, "{objectKey}" is your custom object's identifier, and "{fieldName}" is the unique field name within that object. Example: "custom_object.pet.name" for a "name" field in a "pet" custom object.
  - allowCustomOption boolean - Determines if users can add a custom option value different from the predefined options in records for RADIO type fields. A custom value added in one record does not automatically become an option and will not appear as an option for other records.

### Create Pipeline
POST /opportunities/pipelines
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/opportunities/pipelines
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/opportunities/create-pipeline | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/opportunities/create-pipeline.md

Creates a new pipeline with at least one stage for a given location. Pipeline names must be unique per location (case-insensitive), and stage names must be unique within the pipeline. To enable manual win probability, set `useOpportunityProbability` to `true` and provide a `stageWinProbability` (0–100) on every stage — if any stage is missing a value, the system falls back to auto-computed probabilities based on stage position.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: pipelines.create

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreatePipelineDto:
- name* string (e.g. "pipeline") - Name of the pipeline
- stages* string[] - List of stages belonging to this pipeline
- showInFunnel boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the funnel view
- showInPieChart boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the pie chart view
- useOpportunityProbability boolean - Whether stage-level win probability is enabled for this pipeline
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT") - Identifier of the location (sub-account) this pipeline belongs to
- colorRenderMode string (enum: dot | bg-tint | none; e.g. "dot") - How pipeline/stage colors are rendered

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- id string - Unique identifier of the pipeline
- name string - Name of the pipeline
- stages any[][] - Stages belonging to this pipeline
- showInFunnel boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the funnel view
- showInPieChart boolean - Whether the pipeline is shown in the pie chart view
- locationId string - Identifier of the location (sub-account) this pipeline belongs to
- useOpportunityProbability boolean - Whether stage-level win probability is enabled for this pipeline
- colorRenderMode string (enum: dot | bg-tint | none) - How pipeline/stage colors are rendered
- position string - Fractional-index key used to sort pipelines. Updated when the user reorders pipelines (via drag-and-drop or the reorder modal).

Errors: 400, 401 (400, 401: see Common error responses)

### Create Coupon
POST /payments/coupon

The "Create Coupon" API allows you to create a new promotional coupon with customizable parameters such as discount amount, validity period, usage limits, and applicable products. Use this endpoint to set up promotional offers and special discounts for your customers.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: payments/coupons.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateCouponParams:
- altId* string (e.g. "BQdAwxa0ky1iK2sstLGJ") - Location Id
- altType* string (enum: location; e.g. "location") - Alt Type
- name* string (e.g. "New Year Sale") - Coupon Name
- code* string (e.g. "LEVELUPDAY2022") - Coupon Code
- discountType* string (enum: percentage | amount; e.g. "amount") - Discount Type
- discountValue* number (e.g. 10) - Discount Value
- startDate* string (e.g. "2023-01-01T22:45:00.000Z") - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- endDate string (e.g. "2023-01-31T22:45:00.000Z") - End date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- usageLimit number (e.g. 10) - Max number of times coupon can be used
- productIds string[] (e.g. ["6241712be68f7a98102ba272"]) - Product Ids
- priceIds string[] (e.g. ["6241712be68f7a98102ba272"]) - Price Ids
- variantIds string[] (e.g. ["6241712be68f7a98102ba272"]) - Variant Ids
- applyToFuturePayments boolean (default: true) - Is Coupon applicable on upcoming subscription transactions
- applyToFuturePaymentsConfig object (default: {"type":"forever"}) - If coupon is applicable on upcoming subscription transactions, how many months should it be applicable for a subscription
  - type* string (enum: forever | fixed; e.g. "forever | fixed") - Type of the config
  - duration* number (e.g. 5) - Duration the coupon to be applied in a subscription
  - durationType* string (enum: months; e.g. "months") - Type of the duration
- limitPerCustomer boolean (default: false) - Limits whether a coupon can be redeemed only once per customer.

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - Unique MongoDB identifier for the coupon
- usageCount* number - Number of times the coupon has been used
- limitPerCustomer* number - Maximum number of times a customer can use this coupon (0 for unlimited)
- altId* string - Location Id
- altType* string - Type of entity
- name* string - Display name of the coupon
- code* string - Redemption code for the coupon
- discountType* string (enum: percentage | amount) - Type of discount (percentage or amount)
- discountValue* number - Value of the discount (percentage or fixed amount)
- status* string (enum: scheduled | active | expired) - Current status of the coupon
- startDate* string - Date when the coupon becomes active
- endDate string - End date when the coupon expires
- applyToFuturePayments* boolean - Indicates if the coupon applies to future recurring payments
- applyToFuturePaymentsConfig* object - Configuration for how the coupon applies to future payments
  - type* string (enum: forever | fixed) - Type of future payments configuration
  - duration number - Duration value for fixed type configurations
  - durationType string - Duration type for fixed configurations (e.g. months)
- userId string - User ID associated with the coupon (if applicable)
- createdAt* string - Creation timestamp
- updatedAt* string - Last update timestamp
- traceId* string - Unique identifier for tracing this API request

Errors: 422 (422: see Common error responses)

      - updatedAt* string (format: date-time) - The last update timestamp of the product.

      - isTaxesEnabled boolean (default: false) - The field indicates whether taxes are enabled for the product or not.
      - taxes string[] - An array of ids of Taxes attached to the Product. If the expand query includes tax, the taxes will be of type `ProductTaxDto`. Please refer to the `ProductTaxDto` for additional details.

        - intervalCount* number - The number of intervals between each occurrence of the event.

### List active numbers
GET /phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/phone-system/numbers/location/{locationId}
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/phone-system/active-numbers | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/phone-system/active-numbers.md

List active numbers. With `version: v3`, the HTTP 200 body is the standard success envelope (`status`, `data`, `message`, `statusCode`). The v3 list payload is under `data`; `isUnderGhl` is renamed to `isUnderLc` per AIP naming convention.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: phonenumbers.read

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- locationId* string (e.g. "tDtDnQdgm2LXpyiqYvZ6") - Location ID as string

Query parameters:
- pageSize number (min: 1; max: 1000; e.g. 50) - How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.
- page number (min: 0; e.g. 0) - The page index. The default is 0.
- searchFilter string (e.g. "+91") - Number search Filter
- skipNumberPool boolean (default: true) - When true, exclude numbers assigned to number pools from the list.
- includeRcsSenderIds boolean - Include RCS Sender IDs

Response 200 (Success envelope; v3 list details are in `data` (including `isUnderLc` instead of legacy `isUnderGhl`).) application/json:
- status* string (enum: success) - Outcome indicator from the shared success helper.
- data* object - V3 list payload: numbers, pagination fields, isUnderLc (renamed from isUnderGhl), etc.
  - numbers* object[] - Active numbers available for the location
    - phoneNumber* string - Phone number in E.164 format
    - friendlyName string - Human-friendly label for the number
    - sid string - Provider number identifier
    - countryCode string - ISO country code for the number
    - capabilities object - Phone number capabilities
      - voice boolean - Whether the number supports voice calls
      - sms boolean - Whether the number supports SMS
      - mms boolean - Whether the number supports MMS
      - fax boolean - Whether the number supports fax
    - type string - Phone number type
    - isDefaultNumber boolean - Whether this is the default outbound number
    - linkedUser string (nullable) - Linked user ID if the number is assigned
    - linkedRingAllUsers string[] - Ring-all user IDs linked to the number
    - inboundCallService object - Inbound call service metadata
    - forwardingNumber string - Forwarding number in E.164 format
    - isGroupConversationEnabled boolean - Whether group conversations are enabled
    - addressSid string - Address SID used for regulated number purchases
    - bundleSid string - Bundle SID used for regulated number purchases
    - dateAdded object - Date the number was added
    - dateUpdated object - Date the number was last updated
    - dateCreated object - Legacy created-at field returned by some providers
    - origin string - Provider origin for the number
  - isUnderLc boolean - Whether the account is managed under LC. Renamed from isUnderGhl.
  - pageSize number - The page size requested
  - page number - The zero-based page index requested
  - accountStatus string - Twilio account status for the location
  - rcsSenderIds object[] - Optional RCS sender IDs returned with the number list
    - number* string - RCS sender ID
    - numberType* string - Entry type
    - friendlyName string - Human-friendly label for the sender ID
    - rcsMeta object - RCS sender metadata
  - total number - Total number of active numbers when available
- message* string - Human-readable success message.
- statusCode* number - HTTP status echoed in the response body.

- countryCode* string (e.g. "US") - country for which the phone numbers are being requested
- numberType* object (e.g. "local") - type of phone number to be purchased
- paymentIntentId* string (e.g. "pi_3Oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx") - stripe payment intent id
- stripeAccountId* string (e.g. "acct_1Oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx") - stripe account id
- paymentMethodId* string (e.g. "pm_1Oxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx") - stripe registered payment method id
- locality* string (e.g. "Austin") - locality of the user in which number is being purchased
- region* string (e.g. "TX") - region of the user in which number is being purchased
- fingerprintId* string (e.g. "purchase-req-abc-123") - fingerprintId is request id which is unique for every purchase number request
- skipLocationKYC* boolean - Skip location-level KYC verification if agency-level compliance has already been verified

Response 201 (Success envelope; v3 purchase details are in `data` (slim shape: number, locationId, id, underLcAccount).) application/json:
- status* string (enum: success) - Outcome indicator from the shared success helper.
- data* object - V3 purchase payload: purchased number, location, Twilio account id, and underLcAccount.
  - number* string - E.164 phone number that was purchased (from the request body)
  - locationId* string - Location that owns the Twilio / numbers account
  - id* string - Twilio account document identifier
  - underLcAccount* boolean - Whether the account is managed under LC. Renamed from under_ghl_account in the legacy document.
- message* string - Human-readable success message.
- statusCode* number - HTTP status echoed in the response body.

### Create Price for a Product
POST /products/{productId}/price
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/products/{productId}/price
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/create-price-for-product | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/ghl/products/create-price-for-product.md

The "Create Price for a Product" API allows adding a new price associated with a specific product to the system. Use this endpoint to create a price with the specified details for a particular product. Ensure that the required information is provided in the request payload.

Auth (any one of):
- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products/prices.write
- Agency token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products/prices.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:
- productId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - ID of the product that needs to be used

Request body (required) (application/json) CreatePriceDto:
- name* string (e.g. "Price Name") - The name of the price.
- type* string (enum: one_time | recurring; e.g. "one_time") - The type of the price.
- currency* string (e.g. "USD") - The currency of the price.
- amount* number (e.g. 99.99) - The amount of the price. ( min: 0 )
- recurring object - The recurring details of the price (if type is recurring).
  - interval* string (enum: day | month | week | year; e.g. "day") - The interval at which the recurring event occurs.
  - intervalCount* number (e.g. 1) - The number of intervals between each occurrence of the event.
- description string - A brief description of the price.
- membershipOffers object[] - An array of membership offers associated with the price.
  - label* string (e.g. "top_50") - Membership offer label
  - value* string (e.g. "50") - Membership offer label
  - _id* string (e.g. "655b33aa2209e60b6adb87a7") - The unique identifier for the membership offer.
- trialPeriod number (e.g. 7) - The trial period duration in days (if applicable).
- totalCycles number (e.g. 12) - The total number of billing cycles for the price. ( min: 1 )
- setupFee number (e.g. 10.99) - The setup fee for the price.
- variantOptionIds string[] (e.g. ["option_id_1","option_id_2"]) - An array of variant option IDs associated with the price.
- compareAtPrice number (e.g. 19.99) - The compare at price for the price.
- locationId* string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The unique identifier of the location associated with the price.
- userId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The unique identifier of the user who created the price.
- meta object - Additional metadata associated with the price.
  - source* string (enum: stripe | woocommerce | shopify; e.g. "stripe") - The source of the price.
  - sourceId string (e.g. "123") - The id of the source of the price from where it is imported
  - stripePriceId* string (e.g. "price_123") - The Stripe price ID associated with the price.
  - internalSource* string (enum: agency_plan | funnel | membership | communities | gokollab | calendar; e.g. "agency_plan") - The internal source of the price.
- trackInventory boolean - Need to track inventory stock quantity
- availableQuantity number (e.g. 5) - Available inventory stock quantity
- allowOutOfStockPurchases boolean - Continue selling when out of stock
- sku string (e.g. "sku_123") - The unique identifier of the SKU associated with the price
- shippingOptions object - Shipping options of the Price
  - weight object - Weight options of the product
    - value* number (e.g. 10) - Actual weight of the product
    - unit* string (enum: kg | lb | g | oz; e.g. "kg") - Weight unit of the product
  - dimensions object - Dimensions of the product
    - height* number (e.g. 10) - Height of the price
    - width* number (e.g. 10) - Width of the price
    - length* number (e.g. 10) - Length of the price
    - unit* string (enum: cm | in | m; e.g. "cm") - Unit of the price dimensions
- isDigitalProduct boolean - Is the product a digital product
- digitalDelivery string[] - Digital delivery options

Response 201 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - The unique identifier for the price.
- membershipOffers object[] - An array of membership offers associated with the price.
  - label* string - Membership offer label
  - value* string - Membership offer label
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the membership offer.
- variantOptionIds string[] - An array of variant option IDs associated with the price.
- locationId string - The unique identifier for the location.
- product string - The unique identifier for the associated product.
- userId string - The unique identifier for the user.
- name* string - The name of the price.
- type* string (enum: one_time | recurring) - The type of the price (e.g., one_time).
- currency* string - The currency code for the price.
- amount* number - The amount of the price.
- recurring object - The recurring details of the price (if type is recurring).
  - interval* string (enum: day | month | week | year) - The interval at which the recurring event occurs.
  - intervalCount* number - The number of intervals between each occurrence of the event.
- createdAt string (format: date-time) - The creation timestamp of the price.
- updatedAt string (format: date-time) - The last update timestamp of the price.
- compareAtPrice number - The compare-at price for comparison purposes.
- trackInventory boolean - Indicates whether inventory tracking is enabled.
- availableQuantity number - Available inventory stock quantity
- allowOutOfStockPurchases boolean - Continue selling when out of stock

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

- isLabelEnabled boolean (default: false) - Is the product label enabled. If this is true, label object cannot be empty.

  - title* string (e.g. "Featured") - The content for the product label.
  - startDate string (e.g. "2024-06-26T05:43:35.000Z") - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
  - endDate string (e.g. "2024-06-30T05:43:39.000Z") - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- slug string (e.g. "awesome-product") - The slug using which the product navigation will be handled
- seo object - SEO data for the product that will be displayed in the preview
  - title string (e.g. "Best Product - Buy Now") - SEO title
  - description string (e.g. "This is the best product you can buy online with amazing features and great value") - SEO description

  - name* string - The name of the variant.
  - options* object[] - An array of options for the variant.
    - id* string - The unique identifier for the option.
    - name* string - The name of the option.
- locationId* string - The unique identifier for the location.
- name* string - The name of the product.
- productType* string - The type of the product (e.g., PHYSICAL).
- availableInStore boolean - Indicates whether the product is available in-store.
- createdAt* string (format: date-time) - The creation timestamp of the product.
- updatedAt* string (format: date-time) - The last update timestamp of the product.
- statementDescriptor string - The statement descriptor for the product.
- image string - The URL for the product image.
- collectionIds string[] - An array of category Ids for the product
- isTaxesEnabled boolean (default: false) - The field indicates whether taxes are enabled for the product or not.

- automaticTaxCategoryId string - Tax category ID for Automatic taxes calculation.

  - title* string - The content for the product label.
  - startDate string - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
  - endDate string - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format

- userId string (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - The unique identifier of the user who created the price.
- meta object - Additional metadata associated with the price.
  - source* string (enum: stripe | woocommerce | shopify; e.g. "stripe") - The source of the price.
  - sourceId string (e.g. "123") - The id of the source of the price from where it is imported
  - stripePriceId* string (e.g. "price_123") - The Stripe price ID associated with the price.
  - internalSource* string (enum: agency_plan | funnel | membership | communities | gokollab | calendar; e.g. "agency_plan") - The internal source of the price.
- trackInventory boolean - Need to track inventory stock quantity
- availableQuantity number (e.g. 5) - Available inventory stock quantity
- allowOutOfStockPurchases boolean - Continue selling when out of stock
- sku string (e.g. "sku_123") - The unique identifier of the SKU associated with the price
- shippingOptions object - Shipping options of the Price
  - weight object - Weight options of the product
    - value* number (e.g. 10) - Actual weight of the product
    - unit* string (enum: kg | lb | g | oz; e.g. "kg") - Weight unit of the product
  - dimensions object - Dimensions of the product
    - height* number (e.g. 10) - Height of the price
    - width* number (e.g. 10) - Width of the price
    - length* number (e.g. 10) - Length of the price
    - unit* string (enum: cm | in | m; e.g. "cm") - Unit of the price dimensions
- isDigitalProduct boolean - Is the product a digital product
- digitalDelivery string[] - Digital delivery options

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:
- _id* string - The unique identifier for the price.
- membershipOffers object[] - An array of membership offers associated with the price.
  - label* string - Membership offer label
  - value* string - Membership offer label
  - _id* string - The unique identifier for the membership offer.
- variantOptionIds string[] - An array of variant option IDs associated with the price.
- locationId string - The unique identifier for the location.
- product string - The unique identifier for the associated product.
- userId string - The unique identifier for the user.
- name* string - The name of the price.
- type* string (enum: one_time | recurring) - The type of the price (e.g., one_time).
- currency* string - The currency code for the price.
- amount* number - The amount of the price.
- recurring object - The recurring details of the price (if type is recurring).
  - interval* string (enum: day | month | week | year) - The interval at which the recurring event occurs.
  - intervalCount* number - The number of intervals between each occurrence of the event.
- createdAt string (format: date-time) - The creation timestamp of the price.
- updatedAt string (format: date-time) - The last update timestamp of the price.
- compareAtPrice number - The compare-at price for comparison purposes.
- trackInventory boolean - Indicates whether inventory tracking is enabled.
- availableQuantity number - Available inventory stock quantity
- allowOutOfStockPurchases boolean - Continue selling when out of stock

Errors: 400, 401, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)

The "Update Product by ID" API allows modifying information for a specific product using its unique identifier. Use this endpoint to update details for a single product based on the provided product ID.

- Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: products.write

- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: v3 (required)

Path parameters:

Request body (required) (application/json) UpdateProductDto:

- description string (e.g. "Product description goes here.") - A brief description of the product.
- productType* string (enum: DIGITAL | PHYSICAL | SERVICE | PHYSICAL/DIGITAL)
- image string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/ghl-test/3SwdhCsvxI8Au3KsPJt6/media/65af8d5df88bdb4b1022ee90.png") - The URL for the product image.

- availableInStore boolean - Indicates whether the product is available in-store.

  - title string (e.g. "1dd7dcd0-e71d-4cf7-a06b-6d47723d6a29.png") - The title of the media file.
  - url* string (e.g. "https://storage.googleapis.com/ghl-test/3SwdhCsvxI8Au3KsPJt6/media/sample.png") - The URL where the media file is stored.

  - priceIds any[][] (e.g. "6578278e879ad2646715ba9c") - Mongo ObjectIds of the prices for which the media is assigned
- variants object[] - An array of variants for the product.

  - name* string (e.g. "Size") - The name of the variant.
  - options* object[] - An array of options for the variant.
    - id* string (e.g. "h4z7u0im2q8") - The unique identifier for the option.
    - name* string (e.g. "XL") - The name of the option.
- collectionIds string[] (e.g. ["65d71377c326ea78e1c47df5","65d71377c326ea78e1c47d34"]) - An array of category Ids for the product
- isTaxesEnabled boolean (default: false) - Are there any taxes attached to the product. If this is true, taxes array cannot be empty.

- automaticTaxCategoryId string (e.g. "65d71377c326ea78e1c47df5") - Tax category ID for Automatic taxes calculation.
- isLabelEnabled boolean (default: false) - Is the product label enabled. If this is true, label object cannot be empty.

  - title* string (e.g. "Featured") - The content for the product label.

  - endDate string (e.g. "2024-06-30T05:43:39.000Z") - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
- slug string (e.g. "awesome-product") - The slug using which the product navigation will be handled
- seo object - SEO data for the product that will be displayed in the preview
  - title string (e.g. "Best Product - Buy Now") - SEO title
  - description string (e.g. "This is the best product you can buy online with amazing features and great value") - SEO description
- taxInclusive boolean (default: false) - Whether the taxes should be included in the purchase price
- prices string[] - The prices of the product

Response 200 (Successful response) application/json:

- description string - product description
- variants object[] - An array of variants for the product.
  - id* string - A unique identifier for the variant.
  - name* string - The name of the variant.
  - options* object[] - An array of options for the variant.
    - id* string - The unique identifier for the option.
    - name* string - The name of the option.
- locationId* string - The unique identifier for the location.
- name* string - The name of the product.
- productType* string - The type of the product (e.g., PHYSICAL).
- availableInStore boolean - Indicates whether the product is available in-store.
- createdAt* string (format: date-time) - The creation timestamp of the product.
- updatedAt* string (format: date-time) - The last update timestamp of the product.
- statementDescriptor string - The statement descriptor for the product.
- image string - The URL for the product image.
- collectionIds string[] - An array of category Ids for the product
- isTaxesEnabled boolean (default: false) - The field indicates whether taxes are enabled for the product or not.
- taxes string[] - An array of ids of Taxes attached to the Product. If the expand query includes tax, the taxes will be of type `ProductTaxDto`. Please refer to the `ProductTaxDto` for additional details.
- automaticTaxCategoryId string - Tax category ID for Automatic taxes calculation.

  - title* string - The content for the product label.
  - startDate string - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
  - endDate string - Start date in YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format

  - status* string[] (enum: draft | sent | viewed | completed | accepted) - Document status
  - paymentStatus* string[] (enum: waiting_for_payment | paid | no_payment) - Payment status
